calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR929 crore (+15% YoY), PBT margin 16.2%, gross margin 39.9% up 100bp YoY; Bharuch ramp slow at ~INR50 crore quarterly revenue, near breakeven, with utilisation 40-45% on SRB lines.

calls.name: Carysil Ltd
calls.gLine: Stainless steel capacity addition: 150,000 units by March 2027 (Mar 2027)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 27% to INR56 cr at 21.2% margin on volume and mix; capacity at 88% (quartz) and 94% (SS) with 250k quartz expansion due by FY27 end, but logistics delays shifted some dispatches into Q2.

calls.name: Orient Bell Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 42.8% to INR203 cr with record 39.7% gross margin and utilisation 73% vs 64% in Q4, helped by Morbi shutdown and a 15.9% ASP rise; management gives no guidance.

calls.name: Fairchem Organics Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation exit FY27: 70% to 75% (FY27 exit)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 176 cr (+34.4% YoY) and EBITDA margin 10.14% on price realisation from import pressure easing; utilisation only ~60% with target 70-75% exit FY27.

calls.name: S.J.S. Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Decoplast revenue doubling: Double sales in 3 to 4 years (3-4 years)
calls.thesis: Record Q1FY27 revenue Rs 2,610 mn (+24.5% YoY) and 27th straight quarter of outperformance, but adjusted PAT margin 19.3% and no peer or industry capacity data; supply-side evidence thin.

calls.name: Allcargo Terminals Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex plan: close to INR400 crores over Plan 2030; ~INR100 crores in FY27 (FY27-FY30)
calls.thesis: Container terminal (CFS) operator: Q1 FY27 volumes +7.2% to 1,76,499 TEUs, EBITDA/TEU guided to stay INR2,400-2,500 as capacity rises ~20% to 1.03m TEU, with ~INR400cr capex plan funded partly by equity.

calls.name: GPT Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: ~21% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR126.2 cr, EBITDA margin 20.4%, PAT up 66%; mature-hospital occupancy 58.07% and ARPOB gains are mix-led, with Raipur losses (INR3 cr) and greenfield capex keeping capital intensity in focus.

calls.name: Studds Accessories Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin Q2 FY27: 14% to 15% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin hit from styrene spike (INR135 to ~INR225 peak) is being passed through with 9% price hike, with EBITDA guided back to 14-15% in Q2 and 18-20% by Q4 FY27 if raw materials hold; utilisation 81% and 1.5m helmet capacity from October.

calls.name: Juniper Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 run-rate EBITDA: close to INR 4,500 crores on ~6 GW (FY28)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with 601 MW commissioned and CUF 30.2%, but no capacity cuts or utilisation tailwind; the story is contracted build-out and a BESS-led pivot, with tariffs and EBITDA guidance that depend on execution.

calls.name: LEAP India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth YoY: 20%+ (FY27 and long term)
calls.thesis: Pallet pooling leader LEAP grows revenue 19% and EBITDA 21% in Q1 FY27 while trimming asset capex to INR76 crore from INR110 crore, with utilisation up to 89.2% and no new capacity push.

calls.name: Pitti Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Lamination volume FY27: 82,000 tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Pitti's sheet-metal utilisation rose to 73% from 70% and machining to 86% from 82%, with the Lamination target raised to 82,000 tons; but margins are flat near 16.8% and machining is the bottleneck.

calls.name: Electronics Mart India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 18% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +39% to INR 2,419 cr and EBITDA margin 9.9%, but much of the lift is a weak-base summer and temporary chip-price gains; FY27 guided at 18-20% revenue growth and post-Ind AS EBITDA margin 7.5-8%.

calls.name: Aarti Pharmalabs Ltd
calls.gLine: Xanthine FY27 revenue: INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Xanthine-led Q1 FY27 revenue up 42% to INR535 cr with spot pricing lifted by China rebate removal and raw-material spike, but management itself expects realisations to fall and Xanthine FY27 sales of INR900-1,000 cr.
calls.top: Realisation per kg to decline in Q2

calls.name: Vibhor Steel Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: Monthly sales increase Q2: +1,000 t, ~10 CR monthly
calls.thesis: Vibhor's Q1 FY27 pipe volumes are capacity-constrained by galvanizing tanks, with a 20% top-line rise led by Jharsuguda and capex (new galvanizing tank) only now being added; Jindal still ~80% of revenue.

calls.name: Dee Development Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: >Rs 2,000 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 294.5 cr (+31.6% YoY) with Rs 25 cr slipped to Q2; capacity ramp at Anjar and seamless plant support margins, but Anjar utilisation only 60-65% and inflow guidance of Rs 2,000 cr is unchanged.

calls.name: Leela Palaces Hotels & Resorts Ltd
calls.gLine: Srinagar and Bandhavgarh opening: Oct-Dec 2027 (CY27)
calls.thesis: Leela Q1 FY27 RevPAR +17% (occupancy 67.5%, ADR +10%) and EBITDA margin 41%, but this is a demand-led hotel story with no supply discipline signal; capacity is expanding (10 pipeline properties, 1,000+ keys) rather than being cut.

calls.name: Aditya Infotech Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 price increase for the year: around 25%
calls.thesis: CP PLUS-led Q1 FY27 revenue of INR1,402 crores (+89.5% YoY) with EBITDA margin 14.8%; capacity ~2.5 million units/month at 85-90% utilisation, with capex to roughly double capacity over three years, but price pass-through of 10-20% is the main margin driver.

calls.name: Apollo Tyres Ltd
calls.gLine: India sequential RM inflation Q2: about 8% sequentially
calls.thesis: Apollo Tyres India volumes grew ~12% with price hikes of 7-9% only partly in Q1 revenue; management says 15-16% needed and only 11%+ announced, with RM still rising ~8% into Q2.

calls.name: Kalyani Forge Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: sustain 15% or more; internal target 20% over coming quarters (coming quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin-led beat: EBITDA margin 16.2% vs 9.3% a year ago, but forging utilisation only 50-60% and capex of ₹30 crore is modest, so supply discipline is good and no capacity race is evident.

calls.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
calls.gLine: Ethanol capacity utilisation: 100-110% of existing capacity by FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA Rs91cr at 14.2% margin on strong ethanol realisations, but management guides FY27 EBITDA margin 10-11% and says Q2 is seasonally weak; capacity debottleneck to 100-110% by FY28 with no major capex until FY28.

calls.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA per kg: INR44-45 for full year (aiming), exceed INR42-43 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA per kg rose to INR46.7 (vs ~INR40.7 FY26) on Hyderabad unit consolidation and mix, while volume grew only ~6% as lube fell 17% on base-oil shortage; price pass-through of raw material held.

calls.name: MTAR Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days FY27 end: ~100 days
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR360.7 cr (+130% YoY) at 23.5% EBITDA margin; management reiterates FY27 ~80% growth at 24% margin and expands fuel-cell capacity, but capex (~INR500 cr) is now partly debt-funded and the call is heavy on unquantified claims.
calls.top: Order book INR5,143 cr at quarter end

calls.name: DIVGI TORQTRANSFER SYSTEMS Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue target: INR 1,000 crore first milestone; INR 2,000 crore addressable potential (not dated)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 141.8 cr (+85% YoY) and EBITDA margin 29.4%, but driven by a one-off Indonesia transfer-case order (~30% dispatched of 70,000 units); no capacity addition announced beyond a planned line upgrade.

calls.name: J.G.Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Dahej EBITDA margin (consolidated target): 14-15% (FY29)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR315.7 cr (+44.8% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.5%, with utilisation in early 80s and Dahej capacity (15-17k t Phase 1) slipping to November; part of margin tied to inventory gains.

calls.name: Lohia Corp Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Woven-plastic machinery maker reported Q1 FY27 revenue INR503 cr (+60% YoY) and EBITDA margin 19.9%, with order book ~INR1,778 cr (+30% QoQ) and utilisation of 70-75%, but no capacity added yet.
calls.top: Order book INR1,780 cr, up 30% QoQ

calls.name: Prasol Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR1,550-1,650 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA INR90.3 cr (20.8% margin) was flattered by ~INR25 cr inventory gain in a price spike; management guides FY27 adjusted EBITDA INR240-250 cr ex-gain, with Phase 1 capex of INR250-300 cr adding ~60,000 t.
calls.top: Q1 INR25 cr inventory gain flatters EBITDA

calls.name: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin of 30.3% on revenue of INR633 crore (+28% YoY) with mix-led gains; management reaffirmed FY27 INR2,500 crore revenue and 25% ±2% margin, with capacity additions in H1 FY28 rather than near term.

calls.name: Shaily Engineering Plastics Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin normalisation: back to normalised level by Q3
calls.thesis: Healthcare pen revenue up 85% to INR142 cr (51% mix) on ~9 million pens in Q1, but utilisation only 50.2% and gross margin fell QoQ on pass-through lags; 36 million FY27 guidance said beatable.

calls.name: GEE Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue: INR 1,000 cr by FY29-30 (FY2029-30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 30% YoY to INR 103 cr and EBITDA margin 7.8% (from 5.7%), but growth rests on a 71,000 MT wire capacity plan and an unquantified INR 1,000 cr target with no prior guidance to test against.

calls.name: Gufic Biosciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Indore capacity utilisation: 40% to 45% by year-end FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gufic's Indore plant is ramping from ~30% toward 40–45% utilisation by year-end with no new capex; Q1 revenue +15% YoY to INR260.8 cr and EBITDA margin 18.1%, but the revenue ceiling rests on management's own unverified estimates.

calls.name: GRP Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: close to 20%-plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 60% to INR174m with margin 11% (+233bp) on reclaim volumes +12% and price pass-through; Pyrova still sub-scale, rCB commissioning targeted October 2026 with 18–20% margin only after maturity.

calls.name: Aarti Drugs Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27 (next two years): 10% to 15% volume growth (next two years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth was mostly price-led: API realisations up ~16-17% YoY while volumes rose only ~3.5%, with management admitting demand fell as buyers held stock, and Sayakha utilisation reached ~65%.

calls.name: Sterling Tools Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone fasteners FY27 margin: Hold margin structures on full-year basis
calls.thesis: Standalone fasteners at 90–95% utilisation with ₹88 cr capex mostly in H2 FY27, steel pass-through pending; SEM and STML loss-making with breakeven targeted FY28 at ~₹225–250 cr combined revenue.

calls.name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin (medium term): 32%-33%, plus/minus 1% (next 1-2 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR1,045 cr and EBITDA margin 34.2%, but supply-side read is mixed: HFC 15,000 t capacity on track for Q3 FY27, CDMO Phase 2 capex INR125 cr, and management guides margin 32-33% ±1%.
calls.top: New capex INR90 cr advanced materials

calls.name: Gokaldas Exports Ltd
calls.gLine: Africa EBITDA recovery to double digit: Q4 FY27 or early Q1 FY28
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth led by India (+16% YoY) and Africa (+45%) while Indian apparel exports fell 12%; capacity adds are funded but back-end loaded to FY28-29, and BTPL remains loss-making at about -7.5% to -8% EBITDA.

calls.name: Clean Science and Technology Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue up 5% QoQ to INR203 cr on realisation gains, with HALS at 22% of sales; volume fell YoY on a two-week raw-material shutdown, and the 3,000 t HALS target was reaffirmed.

calls.name: Concord Biotech Ltd
calls.gLine: API revenue FY31 scale: INR2,200-2,300 crores in 5-6 years (5-6 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR257cr (+26%) with API +42% and EBITDA margin 32%, but no capacity addition; Unit 3 utilisation ~55% and Unit 2 ~25% leave ample spare capacity, so supply discipline is intact and growth is partly FY26 spillover.

calls.name: Onesource Specialty Pharma Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR4,490m (+37% YoY) and EBITDA INR1,233m (+39% YoY) on semaglutide and DDC; management reiterates FY28 $400m revenue and 40% margin, with new cartridge line adding sterile capacity, though utilisation is claimed full with no quantified figures.
calls.top: Second cartridge line commissioning this quarter

calls.name: Indiqube Spaces Ltd
calls.gLine: VAS share of revenue: rise by 2% to 4% from 17% (over time)
calls.thesis: Flex-space operator adds 1.91 mn sq ft AUM in the year but rent-paying area flat QoQ; management reiterates ~2 mn sq ft/yr, with 3.9 mn sq ft signed headroom and 90% renewals.

calls.name: Epack Prefab Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Data-centre order in Q2: At least one turnkey PEB order
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~25% to INR366 cr, order book INR1,380 cr; EBITDA margin fell ~100 bps to 9.4% on steel costs, with management guiding FY27 EBITDA margin 10.5% and FY27 revenue INR1,900-1,950 cr.

calls.name: Sundrop Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin (ESOP-adjusted): ~7% today, 12% by FY30 target (3 years)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +15% YoY with EBITDA steady near 7% (ESOP-adjusted ~5.7%); growth is demand and investment-led, with no capacity or supply-discipline signal, and a 12% FY30 margin target that is aspirational.

calls.name: SPML Infra Ltd
calls.gLine: BESS revenue FY27: INR200-300 crore (FY27 (Q4))
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 74% YoY to INR286 crore with EBITDA margin ~10%, but order intake of INR1,293 crore is thin against a >INR5,000 crore FY27 target and BESS revenue depends on NTPC design approval by December.

calls.name: NOCIL Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: Rs 1,400-1,600 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 403 cr (+20% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.2%, but volumes fell 3% QoQ on supply constraints; FY27 guided Rs 1,400-1,600 cr revenue and ~10% EBITDA, with ADD on Sulphonamides in force and Pilflex 13 pending.

calls.name: Ipca Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: 14% to 16% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated sales up 21% to INR2,788 crores with EBITDA margin 22.88%; management raised FY27 growth guidance to 14-16% and margin to around 23%, but gains were mostly from rupee and cost-line mix, not materials.

calls.name: Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Phase-2 to 66,000 MT: by September 2027 (Sep 2027)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 19% to Rs 666 cr with ~25% EBITDA margin claimed, but Phase-1 capacity slipped to September 2026 and gross margin fell ~650bps; capex Rs 850-900 cr over three years.

calls.name: Technocraft Industries (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Scaffolding volumes next two quarters: maintain or better Q1 volumes
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin spike is partly volume and rupee-driven; management refuses to raise sustainable margin guidance (Drum 30%, Scaffolding/Engineering 15%), and capex is maintenance-only this year, a supply-discipline positive.

calls.name: Metropolis Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: Specialty share of revenue: 45% from 40% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% to INR 450 cr on volume (patients +10%, tests +11%) with no price hike; EBITDA margin 25.2% (+210 bps), but supply-side discipline is mostly absent as 500+ net centres are being added.

calls.name: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: ISCS EBITDA margin: back to 9% in Q2; 9.5% to 10% by Q4 (Q2-Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 29% YoY to Rs 3,335 cr with adjusted EBITDA margin 7% (+30 bps); ISCS margin dipped to 8.1% on onboarding costs, GFS rose to 4.1%, and management targets 4% PBT by FY28. Asset-light, not a capacity-cycle story.
calls.top: New business wins Rs 543 cr, record

calls.name: Honasa Consumer Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin expansion FY27: 150-200 bps
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth 32% with 30.5% volume growth, EBITDA near INR110 cr; inventory discipline (distributor stock under 30 days) and calibrated price hikes, but margin lift partly one-time and seasonal.

calls.name: Jyoti CNC Automation Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR200-250 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue +37% to INR509 cr and 86% utilisation with 10,000-machine expansion due September, but Huron revenue recognition switched to delivery-based, cutting consolidated EBITDA margin to 23.4% adjusted.
calls.top: Export licence delays hold Huron revenue

calls.name: Gala Precision Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Effective tax rate: around 20% or less than 20%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ~INR75 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA margin 16.51% with FY27 guided at 17–19%; order book ~INR110 cr vs INR80–85 cr a year ago, but capacity ramp and working-capital study are still pending.

calls.name: Ellenbarrie Industrial Gases Ltd
calls.gLine: East India 320 TPD on-site plant revenue: contribute from Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 987m (+18% YoY) and EBITDA margin 39%, driven by ramp of Kurnool and Uluberia 2 merchant plants; capex Rs 2,500m FY27 and Rs 2,000m FY28 with no contracted demand for North India merchant plant.

calls.name: All Time Plastics Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation FY27: approximately 75% on 41,000 metric tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up 25% QoQ to 6,323 t with utilisation 65% vs 52%, but gross margin fell to 39.5% from 41.9% on polymer cost spike; FY27 utilisation target 75% on 41,000 t.

calls.name: Milky Mist Dairy Food Ltd
calls.gLine: Incremental H2 revenue: INR150-200 crore (H2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR973 crore with EBITDA margin 14.9% vs 12.2% a year ago; growth led by paneer, yogurt and ice cream, with capacity still underutilised (~50% per analyst) and no supply-side discipline signal.

calls.name: Sundram Fasteners Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: closer to 16.5%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated turnover up 20% to INR1,618 crores with ~13% tonnage growth; capex guidance reconciled to roughly INR400 crores with no capacity cuts, while margin guided up to ~16.5% EBITDA as indirect-cost negotiations flow through.

calls.name: Westlife Foodworld Ltd
calls.gLine: G&A as % of sales: 6% to 6.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Westlife (McDonald's India, West & South) grew revenue 12% with SSSG 4.3%, but EBITDA margin slipped on fuel/food/packaging inflation; management guides 100–150 bps annual margin gains and 60+ openings in FY27.

calls.name: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 revenue growth: 15% to 20% (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 37% to INR756 cr and EBITDA margin 14.6%, driven by utilisation of 80–95% across most pharma assets; management says capex is a steady ~INR200 cr a year, with no capacity cut or deferral.

calls.name: Piccadily Agro Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Barrel inventory by March 2027: 1,00,000 barrels, now 1,15,000 to 1,20,000 (Mar 2027)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18% to Rs270.5cr with branded alco-bev up 47% to Rs82.3cr; capacity ramp (Indri ~60%, Chhattisgarh ~50% by year-end) is supply-led growth, but margin guidance is held, not raised, and H1 margin dipped on costs.

calls.name: NRB Bearings Ltd
calls.gLine: FY31 revenue vision: INR3,000 crores aspirational; INR2,700 crores on trailing growth
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 19.2% to INR370 crores and PAT up 15% to INR38 crores; capex of INR270 crores (INR60 crores spent) with a INR130 crore capacity from INR110 crore Unitec JV, but no utilisation or pricing data.
calls.top: Capex INR270 crores; INR60 crores spent

calls.name: Capri Global Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM FY28: INR65,000 crores, 30%+ CAGR (FY28)
calls.thesis: Capri Global Q1 FY27 shows strong growth and ROA above 4%, but gold-loan Stage 2 jumped INR385 crores and the company raised FY28 AUM target to INR65,000 crores with no prior guidance list to check against.

calls.name: Oriental Rail Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated FY27 turnover: around INR700 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16.7% to INR137.6 cr and EBITDA margin 15.2%, but wagon utilisation was ~50% in FY26 and management guided ~500 wagons in Q2 vs 300-odd in Q1, with 3,800-wagon order book and no operating cash flow in FY25-26.

calls.name: Ind-Swift Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: Export sales FY27: ₹750 crore, ~45% CDMO (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin jumped to 17.91% from 5.33% on 21% revenue growth, but capacity utilisation was only about 70% and the call offered no hard supply-side data beyond a planned ₹250 crore capex spend.
calls.top: CDMO ramp slower: ₹5-6 cr in Q1, ₹100-130 cr for two products

calls.name: Ramkrishna Forgings Ltd
calls.thesis: Capex largely done (~Rs 350 cr FY27 guide), utilisation ramp to 75-80% before next capex; net debt cut to Rs 1,900 cr with Rs 500 cr reduction targeted this year, but margin gains partly offset by unpassed energy and shipping costs.

calls.name: PVR Inox Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 film hire cost: 45% to 45.5% of gross
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 footfalls up 8% and EBITDA nearly doubled to INR230 crores at 14% margin; capex trimmed to ~INR350 crores as capital-light share rises, with net cash of INR80 crores.

calls.name: Bigbloc Construction Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: improve further over next two to three quarters from ~8% (2-3 quarters)
calls.thesis: Bigbloc Q1 FY27 utilisation ~69% on 1.3 mn cbm capacity with EBITDA margin ~8% (INR 6 cr on INR 79 cr); pricing hikes promised but MP plant expansion pushed to FY28 start, keeping capacity-add risk alive.

calls.name: Amber Enterprises India Ltd
calls.gLine: Railway/Defence EBITDA margin FY27: 15% to 16%
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +13% to INR3,888 cr and EBITDA +28% to INR337 cr, but PCB margins compressed to ~12% on a two-quarter CCL pass-through lag; electronics FY27 40%+ growth guide reiterated and ILJIN fire adds disruption risk.

calls.name: Galaxy Surfactants Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year EBITDA per MT: INR 24,000 to INR 25,000 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA hit INR 252.5 cr, EBITDA/MT INR 35,458, but management guides the rest of the year to INR 21-22k/MT, implying a sharp normalisation; volume guidance held at 6-8%.

calls.name: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Ltd
calls.gLine: Business disbursements FY27: INR6,000-6,500 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 microfinance recovery: AUM up 11% QoQ to INR4,887 crores, annualised credit cost 2.1% vs 3.2%, NIM 12.5% vs 9.9%, PAT INR12 crores vs INR5 crores; no capacity or supply signal in the call.

calls.name: NDR Auto Components Ltd
calls.gLine: Bharat Seats revenue: INR3,500 crore by 2030 (FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR221.45 crore with 11.88% EBITDA margin; management guides 11-12% margin and INR3,000 crore FY30 endeavour, but JV losses continue and capex is modest at INR40-50 crore a year.

calls.name: Tega Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin: around 15% for full year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Tega's legacy consumables grew 36% with margin at 24.1%, but the group is now mostly Molycop, which contributes 75% of revenue on one month of consolidation; equipment fell 44% and the call gave no capacity or pricing discipline data.
calls.top: Molycop consolidated; net debt down INR32.18bn

calls.name: R R Kabel Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 54% to INR3,168 cr and op EBITDA margin 9% vs 7%, driven by volume (W&C +17%) and ~40% LME-led pricing; capacity additions are modest and utilisation in wires is only 65-70%.

calls.name: Raymond Lifestyle Ltd
calls.gLine: Garmenting EBITDA margin: no firm guidance; double-digit is an endeavour
calls.thesis: Garmenting grew 50% to INR296 crore with EBITDA margin 7.3% and plants full till December, but branded apparel grew only 4% and EBO network shrank 34 net stores; no capacity added, store cuts ongoing.

calls.name: Rubicon Research Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating EBITDA margin FY27: 23% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Rubicon Q1 FY27 revenue INR534 crore (+51% YoY) with op EBITDA margin 24.2% and FY27 margin guide lifted to 23%, but own-capacity constraints keep outsourcing and gross margin pressure in play.
calls.top: FY27 EBITDA margin guide raised to 23%

calls.name: Nephrocare Health Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Dialysis platform grew revenue 23.7% to INR282 cr with 13% guest growth and utilisation at 74%; management kept 15-20% medium-term guidance and gave no capex numbers, so supply discipline is only partly visible.

calls.name: Powerica Ltd
calls.gLine: Genset margin recovery: improve from Q3 onward (Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Genset EBITDA margin squeezed to 5.6% by commodity inflation with price hikes only now rolling in; data centre order book reached INR900 crores (INR1,100 crores by 7 August) but DG capacity is single-shift at 75-80% utilisation.
calls.top: Data-centre order book INR900 cr → INR1,100 cr

calls.name: Horizon Industrial Parks Ltd
calls.gLine: Leasing FY27: 6.5 mn sq ft (FY27)
calls.thesis: Industrial REIT-style platform with 29.5 mn sq ft operational, Q1 revenue INR200 cr (+23%) and 12% re-leasing spreads, but reported net loss of INR12 cr and no capacity-discipline evidence; supply is self-driven expansion, not industry-wide.

calls.name: Hy-Tech Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: ~20% minimum YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR430m but EBITDA margin fell to 19.6% from 21.5%; management attributes it to price pass-through lagging into Q2 and guides ~20% growth and 24-25% margin, with capacity at 60-70% utilisation.
calls.top: Input cost pass-through deferred to Q2

calls.name: Raymond Ltd
calls.gLine: Aerospace mature EBITDA margin: ~25% (longer term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin 15.9% (up from 15.7%); aerospace revenue +40% YoY to INR123 cr but margin fell to 21.2% from 23.7% on expensed R&D; capacity-led growth with a 2 yr-plus greenfield ramp.
calls.top: Aerospace revenue +40% YoY to INR123 cr

calls.name: Voltas Ltd
calls.thesis: Voltas Q1 FY27 RAC volumes +45% and share 17.3% but UCP EBIT only 5.3% as commodity and FX costs passed through with lag; supply-side is a 1.5-2.8m compressor JV with 18-month runway, capex not yet sized.

calls.name: Deccan Gold Mines Ltd
calls.thesis: Deccan Gold turned producer in Q1 FY27 with Jonnagiri selling 59 kg for Rs 87 Cr revenue and ~Rs 6.35 Cr share of PAT, while ~80 kg gold sits unsold in stock; guidance kept but unverified.

calls.name: Carborundum Universal Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated Ceramics sales growth: 23% to 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone sales up 21.2% YoY to INR 846 cr on volume, with EMD exports rising, but Abrasive margins are squeezed by oil-linked and fuel cost push and Foskor and Awuko exits remain unresolved.

calls.name: KEI Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Operating EBITDA margin: 11% to 12% (coming year)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin up on mix and retail, with Sanand greenfield ramp at 50% and new ₹700cr LV/MV capex announced; management stays conservative at 20%+ growth despite industry running near 30%.

calls.name: RACL Geartech Ltd
calls.gLine: Heat-treatment plant trial production: January 2027; full commissioning by end FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue ₹132.6 cr (+22% YoY) with ~59% Europe mix; heat-treatment replacement (~₹40 cr) and ₹35 cr expansion capex add capacity, but no capacity utilisation figure was disclosed.
calls.top: Royal Enfield run-rate 7.5–8k sets/month vs 10k nominated

calls.name: Indo Borax & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: DOT volume FY27: 1,500 tons
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 70.36 cr (+31%) and EBITDA margin 28.1% on price hikes and utilisation, but management guides FY27 to 20% margin and a softer Q2; the Kronox acquisition dominates the call.

calls.name: Manappuram Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Gold loan AUM growth FY27: 25%-30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Gold loan AUM up 12% QoQ to INR54,655 cr standalone with yield up 59 bps to ~18%; management guides FY27 gold growth 25-30% and 500 new branches, but no supply-side capacity data, and microfinance and vehicle books shrinking.
calls.top: Gold loan yield up 59 bps QoQ

calls.name: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper EBITDA per ton before value addition: above INR40,000 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Copper cathode capex (INR200cr, 36kt) is the supply-side story: 18kt phase due Dec 2026, but lead volumes fell on shipping disruption while lead EBITDA/t hit a record INR21,595 on 85% value-added mix.

calls.name: Endurance Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 EBITDA margin: better than Q1 (no number)
calls.thesis: Standalone EBITDA margin 11.2% (13.3% ex-commodity pass-through) with capex held near ₹800 crores; ABS capacity cut from 12 to 9 lakh units as machinery shifted to brake assembly, a supply reallocation rather than discipline.

calls.name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Concurrent construction capacity: 32 platforms by end of calendar year 2026 (CY2026)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 39% to ₹1,815 crore with order book ₹13,596 crore; growth hinges on the pending ₹ NGC contract, expected to be signed this quarter, with revenue only from FY28.

calls.name: Spencers Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: Spencer's full-year online growth: ~25% cumulative (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% YoY to Rs 469 cr with consolidated EBITDA ~Rs 9.4 cr (2% of sales), but growth is volume-led on existing stores with no capacity additions and Nature's Basket still degrowing 13% YoY.

calls.name: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: >60% YoY (potential) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR115.41 cr (+138% YoY) and ~64% EBITDA margin on dredging spillover; management guides FY27 growth above 60% from 30-40%, but Q1 margins are called non-repeatable and the order book is mostly charter.
calls.top: Dredging order book INR750 → INR240 cr

calls.name: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone capex: INR70-80 crore (near term)
calls.thesis: Consolidated EBITDA up 35% to INR175 crore at 26% margin, but PAT up only 6% to INR51 crore; management says major capex cycle is complete with only INR70-80 crore maintenance-type capex ahead.

calls.name: Sansera Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue growth: high-teens to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Sansera posted record Q1 FY27 revenue of INR10,213m (+33% YoY) with capacity being added across ADS and auto; management guides high-teens to 20% FY27 growth, but capex was not updated and the ADS order book rose to ~INR57.5bn.

calls.name: Rainbow Children's Medicare Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: above 20% (Q2 and medium term) (Q2 FY27 and ~4 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 33% reported but 24% like-to-like, EBITDA margin 28.6%, and a 2,500-bed, INR 2,200 crore expansion plan keeps supply rising while new Bengaluru hospitals still lose money.

calls.name: Laxmi Dental Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR74.7cr (+13.9%) and EBITDA margin 19.2%, but growth is mix-led from scanners; no capacity expansion beyond machinery and a Palghar land LOI, with lab utilisation already at 90-95%.

calls.name: ArisInfra Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt-to-equity: 0.5-0.6x ceiling; net debt INR 75-80 cr by FY27 end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Asset-light materials and DaaS platform grew revenue 37% YoY to INR 291 cr with EBITDA margin 10.49%, but supply evidence is thin: contract manufacturing utilisation 65-70% and capacity recycling of deposits to ~11 MT.

calls.name: Shanti Gold International Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin (underlying): 7.5-8% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 144.7% to INR716 cr with EBITDA margin 9.97% flattered by ~2-2.5pt inventory gain; management guides 7.5-8% underlying, 50-60% value and 30-40% volume growth, with rights issue and debt-funded working capital build.

calls.name: Shankara Buildpro Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin steady state: 3.5% plus
calls.thesis: Steel marketplace volumes up 10% YoY to 2.5 lakh tons with EBITDA margin 3.26%; management targets 3.5%+ steady state and 1.2 MT FY27, but Q1 volumes fell 13% QoQ and the April-May price correction cost about Rs 10 crore.

calls.name: Shadowfax Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 38% to 40% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Express volumes up 83% YoY and revenue up 65% to INR1,358 cr with margin at 4.9%; FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to 38-40% from 27-30%, while capex front-loaded in build mode, not supply discipline.

calls.name: Molbio Diagnostics Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue growth FY27: ~25% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Molbio's Truenat point-of-care platform is capacity-rich (kits at 58%, devices at 42% utilisation) with guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 24–25% EBITDA; no prior guidance was supplied to check against.

calls.name: Ester Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 debt repayment: around INR100 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA up 103% to INR58.9 crore with film EBIT margin 9.8% and utilisation 84%, but management withheld firm FY27 guidance and Specialty Polymers revenue fell; other income flatters PAT.

calls.name: Max Financial Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Axis Max Life VNB margin rose to 23.2% (from 20.3%) and VNB grew 33%, driven by protection mix and yield curve, while solvency sits at 198% after Axis's ₹381 crore infusion.

calls.name: Black Box Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: INR7,800-8,000 crore (+23-27%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,719 crore (+24% YoY) and order backlog of about US$950 million (+83%); FY27 guidance kept, with a 10% margin goal pushed to Q4 and beyond.

calls.name: EIH Ltd
calls.thesis: Hotel supply additions are slow; Q1 RevPAR rose ~13% and EBITDA margin fell to ~29% on Rajgarh ramp-up, renovations and marketing, while Kolkata and Grand timelines slipped.

calls.name: Viyash Scientific Ltd
calls.gLine: Animal Health API growth: 20%+ (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 946 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA margin 21.6%, but API flat QoQ on customer wait-and-see; management guides Animal API +20%, company 13-15% growth this year.
calls.top: API customers delayed orders in June

calls.name: RIR Power Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: Core quarterly revenue run-rate: Rs 30+ crore per quarter this year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 27.16 cr (+29.3% YoY) and margin lift from ~80-85% pass-through of metal cost hikes; Odisha epi capacity still pre-revenue, guided Rs 12-15 cr for H2 FY27.

calls.name: MM Forgings Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 20-plus goal; 2-3% squeeze (medium term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume up to ~20,200 t (vs 78,000 t FY26 run-rate) with management guiding 23-25k t per quarter and ~INR1,800-1,900 cr turnover, but working capital and inventory are flagged as needing cuts.

calls.name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA exit: 3%–3.5% by June 2028 (June 2028)
calls.thesis: Credit cost fell to 2.40% from 2.51% and GNPA to 1.37% from 1.44%, with ROA at 1.98%; management gives a June 2028 exit guide of 3–3.5% ROA but no numeric guidance on opex or cost of funds.

calls.name: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue: Up to INR 2,000 crore this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin spike from cheap pre-bought paddy/rice inventory and a ~30% price rise; management guides EBITDA 8-12% oscillation and says revenue could reach INR 2,000 cr, with no capex discussed and volumes flat for three years.

calls.name: R Systems International Ltd
calls.thesis: Revenue Rs 601.7 cr (+30.2% YoY, +4.7% QoQ) with adjusted EBITDA margin 20.1%, but organic growth is muted and management gives no numeric guidance; growth is largely acquisition and rupee aided.

calls.name: V-Guard Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: more than 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: V-Guard Q1 FY27 revenue +23.5% (≈14% price, ≈9% volume) with 10.5% EBITDA margin, but wires volumes near zero as customers defer after steep price hikes and new entrants arrive.

calls.name: Sammaan Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost of funds: 9.3% by end of FY27; 9.6% by September (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT ₹243 crore with net NPA 0.15% and cost of funds falling 10.5% to 10%, but the read is a rerating/funding story, not a supply-side one; disbursement guide ₹30,000 crore this year.

calls.name: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Net debt reduction: Rs 25 crore per quarter from Q3 (FY27 onward)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14% to Rs 662 crore and EBITDA up 21%, but about Rs 15 crore of Flavour sales was pre-emptive stocking, and net debt rose Rs 65 crore to Rs 852 crore on inventory and capex.
calls.top: Net debt up Rs 65 cr to Rs 852 cr

calls.name: Lemon Tree Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: Net EBITDA margin FY28: around 50% (FY28)
calls.thesis: Lemon Tree Q1 FY27: net EBITDA margin fell 99bp to 43.8% on GST input-credit loss and SAR provision; occupancy up 314bp to 75.7% but gross ARR only +2%, with management guiding to a 50% margin next year.
calls.top: Renovation spend tapering to ~1% of revenue

calls.name: Manorama Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Fractionation utilisation FY27: ~80% (management internal target 80-85%) on 52,000 t (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +39.5% YoY to INR 404 cr, volume-led (~85% YoY volume growth); utilisation guided ~80% on 52,000 t capacity after 4,500 t debottleneck due Q3, while management declined to quantify most numbers.

calls.name: Artemis Medicare Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Gurgaon EBITDA margin: 20-21% in FY27; 23-24% over 2-3 years (FY27 to 2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 287.32 cr (+12.7%) and EBITDA margin 21.5%; Gurugram occupancy 65.7% with ~200-bed Tower IV and INR 800 cr three-year capex plan adds supply, with a INR 700 cr equity enabling resolution.

calls.name: Restaurant Brands Asia Ltd
calls.gLine: Marketing spend Q1 vs normal: Q1 6.6% of sales, normalising toward 5-5.5%
calls.thesis: India SSSG 12.6% on traffic with no price hike; gross margin 70.8% targeted to 72% in 3 years, capex discipline, but no capacity or supply-side metrics beyond 80 stores/yr pace and Indonesia capex on hold.

calls.name: Deep Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone revenue growth FY27: 18-20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR278.92 cr (+40% YoY), EBITDA margin 43.6%, order book INR3,047 cr; growth hinges on PEC ramp from H2 and offshore fleet adds, with capex only against firm orders.

calls.name: Alivus Life Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 10% to 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 6.4% to INR640 crores with GPL down 52.6%, offset by non-GPL growth of 26.5%; capacity deliberately paced with Solapur delayed to early Q3 and FY27 revenue guided at 10-12%.
calls.top: GPL inventory rationalisation drives Q1 dip

calls.name: Rolex Rings Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 21% to 22% (conservative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 4.3% to INR304 cr on labour-constrained output (utilisation 63-65%), with export auto components up ~30% and FY27 guided to mid-teens growth, EBITDA margin 22.6%.

calls.name: Muthoot Microfin Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM growth: 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Muthoot Microfin Q1 FY27 shows credit cost falling to 2.6%, cost of funds down to 10.13% and AUM growth guidance raised to 20%, but yields are flat and no capacity or supply metrics were given.

calls.name: Sanathan Textiles Ltd
calls.gLine: Punjab EBITDA per ton FY28: close to INR30,000 per ton (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA up 55% to INR108 cr but margin flat at 8.1% and PAT at INR23.8 cr, with Punjab at 80% utilisation and FY27 EBITDA guidance of INR520-540 cr reiterated.

calls.name: Senores Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 30-40% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Growth-led call with no supply discipline: management is adding capacity (Apnar lines 3 and 4, FY27 capex INR100-120 crores) and guides FY27 revenue +30-40% and PAT +50-60%, with Q1 EBITDA margin near 30% and key figures partly restated on the call.

calls.name: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 collections: ~INR1,000 crore
calls.thesis: Luxury Mumbai developer reports Q1 pre-sales INR409 crore (+567% YoY) and PAT margin 34.5%, but the quarter's sales are largely from FY26 launches and FY27 guidance of INR1,800-2,000 crore pre-sales is reiterated without new supply-side data.

calls.name: Tenneco Clean Air India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR350-450 crore (indicative) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 VAR up 18.4% to INR13,816m but EBITDA margin fell to 17.9% on non-indexed commodity inflation; capacity tight (ART above 90%, CAPT above 80%) with capex INR350-450 crore indicative.

calls.name: Aye Finance Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursement up 22% YoY to INR1,219 cr and credit cost fell to 4.01%, but it sits above the 3.5-4% guide top-end and opex (8.9%) is still above its 8.25-8.75% band, so the quality beat is real but not yet fully priced.

calls.name: Sai Parenterals Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 182 cr (incl. Noumed) with gross margin 41.8% and EBITDA 14.9%; IPO capex re-routed into a 60% stake in a project under construction, with FY27 guidance of Rs 750 cr and 17% EBITDA held.
calls.top: IPO capex redeployed into Saicriti 60% stake

calls.name: India Glycols Ltd
calls.gLine: IGL Spirits EBITDA FY27: >INR500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated net revenue up 9% to INR1,130 crore and EBITDA up 13% to INR170 crore, but a Clariant-dividend-free quarter, a demerger-driven restructuring, and unquantified aspirations make supply-side evidence thin.

calls.name: Novartis India Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue doubling in 4-5 years (organic base): ~2x in 4-5 years
calls.thesis: Post-takeover Novartis India is rebuilding its commercial model: M&A-led growth, ~INR40–50 crore extra quarterly costs from Q2 and a margin dip, with no supply-side capacity signal.
calls.top: Incremental cost INR40-50 crore per quarter

calls.name: Zuari Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Zuari Agro ICD repayment: INR258 crore in current quarter (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Zuari Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA fell to INR31.3 cr from INR36.9 cr and PAT was a loss of INR9.5 cr; profit depends on Dubai repatriation (INR142 cr received of ~INR900 cr guided) and a sugar price rally that is not yet in the numbers.
calls.top: Sugar prices up 10% in a month

calls.name: Flomic Global Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: Momentum for 3-4 quarters, no number
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.4% to INR120 cr and EBITDA margin up 275bp to 9.34%, but management attributes most growth to freight rates (volume only +6-7%) and gives no capacity or capex data, so the read is cyclical freight-rate tailwind rather than supply-side evidence.

calls.name: PCBL Chemical Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: ~INR300 crore +/- INR50 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 carbon black EBITDA/t ~INR22,900 lifted by low-cost inventory (~INR70 cr, INR40-50 cr to reverse); management held FY27 EBITDA/t guidance at INR16,500-17,000 and Q2 volumes soft on timing.

calls.name: Symphony Ltd
calls.gLine: Australia capital deployment: No further capital allocation
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol EBITDA ex one-offs up 39% to ₹53 crore with channel inventory cleared, but management warns of near-term margin pressure from elevated input costs and only partial price pass-through.

calls.name: Batliboi Ltd
calls.gLine: Top-line growth: around 10% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR125 cr (up 80% YoY) with EBITDA margin near 4-6% and PAT INR0.49 cr; backlog INR618 cr and inflow INR283 cr, but no capacity-discipline or pricing evidence and management guides ~10% growth.

calls.name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR4,300-4,500 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR690cr (+129% YoY) and EBITDA margin 12.3%, with management guiding FY27 revenue INR4,300-4,500cr and six-line CCV/MV capacity build; QIP-funded ramp is unproven versus a 34% cable utilisation base.

calls.name: ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone FY27 revenue growth: 10% to 12% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone orders in hand INR 7,727 crore and manufacturing margin held at 12%, but FY27 revenue guided only 10-12% and Philippines ethanol lost INR 83 crore in Q1 at 65% utilisation.
calls.top: Mfg capacity: INR 502 cr approved, ~INR 1,200 cr revenue potential

calls.name: JTL Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Mangaon capacity addition: ~1 million tons by end H1 FY27
calls.thesis: Record Q1 volume of 118,513 t (+17.8% YoY) and company utilisation of 55% rising to ~65% by year-end, but EBITDA/t of ~INR4,954 includes a ~INR200 Defence boost; capacity goes to 2 Mt by FY28-29.

calls.name: Quess Corp Ltd
calls.gLine: Net headcount addition FY27: 30,000 plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Quess Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 4,182 cr (+15% YoY) with EBITDA margin 2.02%, but the Rs 176 cr Labour Code pass-through and Rs 261 cr tax refund flattered headline PAT; underlying General Staffing EBITDA ~1.5% margin, and capital-cycle signals are weak as this is a staffing business with no capacity to cut.
calls.top: Labour Code: Rs 176 cr one-time pass-through

calls.name: Gujarat Fluorochemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: R134A capacity: Commission this financial year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Chemical segment EBITDA up 29% YoY to INR 458 crore on R32 fluorochemicals ramp; R32 at peak utilisation with 20,000 t expansion due Q2 FY27, but battery materials revenue still only INR 20-30 crore and Oman capex shifted to India.

calls.name: Computer Age Management Services Ltd
calls.industry: Depositories, Clearing Houses and Other Intermediaries
calls.gLine: Employee cost growth YoY: around 5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: CAMS Q1 FY27: EBITDA up 18% to INR183 cr with margin 46.4%, but non-MF margin fell to 13% on KRA price cut; management guides ~13% revenue and ~16% EBITDA growth for FY27 with cost growth held under 10%.

calls.name: Veranda Learning Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: approximately INR670 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +42% to INR150 cr and PAT INR34 cr, but EBITDA margin slid to ~36% (34.7% ex-other income) and FY27 guide implies ~38.8% margin; supply-side read is capacity expansion (colleges doubled) expensed upfront, with demerger the main catalyst.

calls.name: Flair Writing Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital improvement: ~10 days (by end of FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +10.6% YoY to INR319.2 cr with EBITDA margin 16.7% (down 46 bps YoY); gross margin hit by West Asia raw-material spike, pricing actions and reiterated 15% FY27 growth guidance.

calls.name: Rashi Peripherals Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 FY27 YoY revenue growth: similar to ~60%, price increase speed halves
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 62% to Rs 5,102 cr with ~30-35pts from price, but management concedes ~10% unit market contraction and channel inventory built up at T2 level.

calls.name: Entero Healthcare Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Effective tax rate FY27: 22.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Entero's Q1 FY27 shows EBITDA margin at 5.0% (+143bp YoY) and organic growth of 19.6% like-for-like, but it is a pharma distributor with no capacity-cycle signals; supply-side metrics are absent and the call leans on guidance reiteration.

calls.name: P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd
calls.gLine: Other expenses FY27: ~INR400 cr, ~3% of sales (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41% to INR2,413 cr and EBITDA margin 8%, but gross margin flat YoY on reported basis and growth is retail/SSSG and bullion-led, with capacity expansion (25 stores) and no capex-discipline signal; supply-side read is neutral.

calls.name: Diffusion Engineers Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: ~20% p.a. FY27-28 (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 36.5% YoY to INR1,101m with order book INR209cr (+20% QoQ); margin dipped to 12.85% on raw-material costs, with mgmt guiding ~20% growth and 100-200bp EBITDA margin recovery over FY27-28.

calls.name: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Blended EBITDA margin: early-to-mid 30s, back from 26-27% pro forma (next couple of years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR893 cr (+12% cc) and 33% reported EBITDA (35% ex-acquisition costs), but TruBridge revenue reset to ~$300m from $340m with EBITDA held at ~$68m; no numeric TruBridge growth guidance.

calls.name: Glottis Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: Exceed FY25 revenue (FY27)
calls.thesis: Glottis is a freight forwarder whose revenue rose 39.5% YoY to Rs 2,345m while TEUs fell to 21,841 from 26,278, so growth is price/mix-led, with EBITDA margin 6.9% and no capacity-discipline evidence beyond its own fleet build.

calls.name: Allcargo Global Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost base (employee and admin) in USD terms: flat over coming couple of years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA turned to INR33 crore from a INR17 crore Q4 and a loss last year, but volumes are still below prior levels and management gave no hard numbers beyond a flat dollar cost intent.
calls.top: LCL and air volumes up about 5% QoQ

calls.name: Physicswallah Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,054 crore (+24% YoY) with pre-Ind AS EBITDA -INR44 crore; management reiterates FY27 30% revenue and 100% EBITDA growth but NEET shift cut Q1 offline growth to 14%.
calls.top: NEET shift cut offline growth to 14%

calls.name: Omnitech Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth (YoY): 35% to 40% per year, FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR166.6 cr (+61.5% YoY) with working-capital days cut to 233 from 294, but capex of INR250 cr is for a new Chhapara plant and management guides 35-40% growth with no numbers on prior targets.

calls.name: One Point One Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.gLine: Consolidated revenue: Roughly double FY27 revenue (qualitative, from analyst Q&A) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue INR 158.3 cr (+129% YoY) mostly from first full quarter of Netcom acquisition; base standalone revenue +11.6% YoY with 30.4% margin, no capacity or pricing data disclosed.

calls.name: EPL Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: high teens for next few quarters (next few quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 reported revenue +25.3% (20% underlying ex pass-through) with EBITDA margin 18.8%; growth guidance raised to high teens but margin held at 20% underlying, while Europe margins contracted and working capital rose on inventory.
calls.top: Capex stepped up ahead of growth

calls.name: JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR1,500 crore (excl. land for Kutch and Nagore) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 realisation up ~9% QoQ mostly from geo-mix and non-trade price gains, but management flags fuel and packaging cost rising into Q2 with pass-through uncertain; utilisation 76%, capex ~INR1,500 cr for FY27.

calls.name: Cosmo First Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated topline growth FY27: about 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA up 26% to Rs 147 cr on 9% volume, but margin fell to 12.6% from 14.5% as pass-through inflated revenue; BOPET margin Rs 9/kg vs Rs 13 a year ago, with ~15% film capacity still unsold.
calls.top: BOPET margin Rs 9/kg vs Rs 13 a year ago

calls.name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
calls.gLine: Pune CCS/bus bar revenue potential: ₹300-400 cr over ~3 years; 10-15% in year 1 (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +33.4% to ₹182.2 cr with margin gain driven by shunt strip-to-part conversion; bimetal utilisation only 40-45% and capacity still idle, so supply discipline is intact but growth is partly silver-led.

calls.name: Steelcast Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 volume growth: 25% (possibly 30%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Steelcast Q1 FY27 revenue up 17% to INR124.8 cr with 66% utilisation in Apr–Jun; management guides ~25% FY27 volume growth and a INR120 cr greenfield foundry, but margin and price pass-through are lagged to 1 July.

calls.name: Usha Martin Ltd
calls.gLine: Plasticated LRPC volume FY27: 3,500 to 4,000 tons (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR 1,033 crore and EBITDA margin 20.1%, but wire rope volumes flat on Middle East volume down 28%; management reiterates 10-12% FY27 volume growth with capacity in place.
calls.top: Steel and zinc costs passed through

calls.name: Websol Energy System Ltd
calls.gLine: TOPCon upgrade completion: by March 2027, cell capacity 1.2 GW to 1.35 GW
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 cell utilisation 92% and module utilisation 81% (from 39%) show the base being used, but EBITDA margin fell to 34% from 47% on module mix, with cell prices soft in the prior quarter and inventory building.

calls.name: Indo Count Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Long-term margin target: 15-16% stabilise
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up 12% QoQ to 23 mn meters and EBITDA margin rebounded to 13.1%, but management reiterated FY27 guidance without a supply cut and Bhilad flood disruption adds risk to H2 volumes.
calls.top: Raw-material price hikes concluded, flow from Q2

calls.name: Apcotex Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Incremental top line from announced capex: about 600 crores (2027)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin of 22.3% on 526 crore revenue, but management says volumes fell 10-12% on export disruption and calls the margin a timing-aided blip; 15-16% is the average view.

calls.name: Neuland Laboratories Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 revenue INR650.1 crore (+16.3% YoY) and EBITDA margin 35.5% on commercial CMS mix, but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and flagged lumpiness from a handful of molecules.

calls.name: Mold-Tek Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: at least 20%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (~19-23% EBITDA, ~15% PAT) rests on MES cost cuts and automation, with Beryl still near break-even; FY27 Rs 240-250 cr reiterated and FY28 Rs 300-350 cr targeted contingent on an unannounced acquisition.
calls.top: Work on hand Rs 4.5m civil vs 3.7m

calls.name: Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin target: 30% in 2-3 years (2-3 years)
calls.thesis: Hotel operator (asset-light, leased) reports Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs 91 cr and EBITDA up 36% to Rs 25 cr; no supply discipline data, capex limited, pipeline ~400 keys in 12-15 months.

calls.name: Axiscades Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 EBITDA (normalised pro forma): Rs270 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Reported loss masks a restructuring: continuing revenue up 94% to Rs183 cr with normalised EBITDA ~Rs41 cr, but management is leaning on unannounced acquisitions and a Rs1,255 cr divestment gain to meet FY27 guidance.

calls.name: UCO Bank
calls.gLine: Cost-to-income: below 50% or around 50% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit squeezed by a Rs 1,237 crore one-time DTA charge; underlying operating profit boosted by ~Rs 800 crore non-recurring TWO recovery, with credit cost 0.39% and CD ratio 82% supporting a 21% advances growth read.

calls.name: Suprajit Engineering Ltd
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue +24% to INR1,070 cr and EBITDA +57%, but standalone EBITDA flat at INR60 cr as India wage inflation squeezed ICM margin from ~15% to 13%; management calls it timing and guides held.

calls.name: Arvind SmartSpaces Ltd
calls.gLine: Launch booking value FY27: INR3,000-3,500 crore across 6 launches
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 presales up 147% to INR432 crore and revenue jumped on one OC, but the read is a real-estate developer with no capacity or utilisation data; guidance held, OCF of INR81 crore vs full-year INR400-500 crore target.

calls.name: Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: mid-teens rather than early teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 19.1% to Rs 798 crore with EBITDA margin 31.0%, driven by CGHS price pass-through (2-3%) and mix; no supply-side capacity signal as management says capacity is never a constraint.
calls.top: Margin guide tilts to mid-teens growth

calls.name: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 21-22% in next 2 years; 24-25% long term (2 years / 4-5 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR6,951m on 11% volume growth, ARPP only +2%; adjusted EBITDA margin 19.4% (+120bp) with management targeting 21-22% in two years and 25% in four to five.

calls.name: Home First Finance Company India Ltd
calls.gLine: BT out rate: around 5% to 6% (near term)
calls.thesis: Housing finance book growing 25.7% YoY with stable asset quality (30+ DPD 3.2%) and spread guided at 5–5.25%; no capacity or pricing-supply signals, growth driven by home loans and ticket size.

calls.name: United Foodbrands Ltd
calls.thesis: Restaurant demand is volume-led with SSSG 28.7% and no price hikes, but no supply discipline signal: 300-store target and capex of INR140 crores imply continued expansion, and the company is a restaurant operator, not a supply-constrained industry.

calls.name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: high double digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ~Rs231 cr (+22.8% YoY) on 16.5% volume growth, EBITDA margin 42.7%, with capex guided at Rs190-195 cr for 9 hubs and 10-12 spokes; supply is expanding steadily while pricing is largely unchanged.

calls.name: Sapphire Foods India Ltd
calls.thesis: QSR operator (KFC, Pizza Hut, Sri Lanka) posted positive SSSG across all three brands with KFC at 5%, but Sri Lanka margins are under pressure and Pizza Hut restaurant EBITDA is negative at -3.6%.

calls.name: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Employee cost growth FY27: 22% to 24% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Prudent's Q1 FY27 is a distributor-platform growth story, not a capital-cycle one: equity AUM up 18% to INR1.34 lakh crore, but gross yield slipped to ~88 bps and commission payout fell after a regulatory reset.

calls.name: Aeroflex Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Optimal skid utilisation: ~80% in FY28
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 72% to INR146cr with SFN data-centre skids 23% of sales, but skid capacity expansion to 15,000 is dependent on machine suppliers and Q3 timing, and margin fell sequentially to ~23%.

calls.name: Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd
calls.gLine: Asset services full-year revenue growth: more than 20-25%
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 quarter: revenue INR909 crore (+18%) and PAT ~INR300 crore, with cost-to-income near 55% and FY guidance held; capital-cycle signals are not the story here, growth and flows are.
calls.top: MPIS net new money record above INR3,000 crore

calls.name: ESAF Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Credit cost: around 2% by year-end (FY27 year-end)
calls.thesis: Asset quality and profitability inflecting: slippages fell to INR 75 crores from INR 468 crores YoY, PAT INR 80 crores, with management guiding ROA to 2% by FY27-end and credit cost to 2%; the capital-cycle signal is credit normalisation, not supply discipline.

calls.name: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Cost to income reduction: 30-40 bps a year (annual)
calls.thesis: Aadhar's Q1 FY27 is a steady housing-finance print: AUM up 18% to ₹31,364 cr, spreads held at 5.8%, but a cheque-realisation accounting shift cut disbursement growth to about 19% on a like-for-like basis and Q1 credit cost rose seasonally.

calls.name: Godavari Biorefineries Ltd
calls.gLine: Bio-chem quarterly revenue: INR190 crore next quarter (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Bio-chemicals revenue up 19.4% to INR168.7 cr with EBITDA up 53%, but consolidated EBITDA fell to INR2.6 cr (0.5% margin) as sugar/ethanol loss widened to INR14.6 cr.

calls.name: Ventive Hospitality Ltd
calls.gLine: Maldives margin recovery: Q3/Q4 to offset Q1-Q2 fuel hit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Hospitality revenue up 9% to INR420 crores with India EBITDA up 16%; reported consolidated EBITDA fell about INR16 crores on Maldives diesel spike, with 1.2x net debt/EBITDA and no new capacity commitments beyond the pipeline.

calls.name: Jash Engineering Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs156 crore (+17% YoY) with PAT turned positive at Rs5 crore; Rs932 crore order book and FY27 Rs875 crore target reiterated, but Middle East and Singapore shipments of about Rs15 crore are stuck.

calls.name: Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross store additions FY27: more than 300 stores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 11% to Rs 2,046 cr and EBITDA margin up 50 bps to 16%, but gross margin fell ~150 bps on channel mix and provisioning; supply-side signals are absent and the company is guiding 300+ gross store adds.

calls.name: Bluspring Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Long-term ROE and EBITDA margin: 20% ROE, 5.5-6% EBITDA margin, pulled to FY29 (FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 organic-plus-STEAG growth looks solid, but the story is acquisition-led: FY27 guidance of INR4,700 crore revenue and INR200 crore EBITDA hinges on STEAG, foundit burn of INR30-35 crore and rising working-capital days toward 45.

calls.name: M & B Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Medium-term CAGR: >20% over 3-4 years (FY28-FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 22.5% to INR291 cr with capacity adds in H2, but margins squeezed by freight; management withheld FY27 margin guidance, citing volatility, while holding ~25% revenue growth.

calls.name: Urban Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Urban Company Q1 FY27 NTV up 42% to ₹1,465 crore with Services NTV growth accelerating to 29%, but InstaHelp loss of ₹(132) crore keeps consolidated profitability and the breakeven target in focus.

calls.name: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Service EBITDA margin: about 16% then 18%, reaching 23-24% over 4-5 years (FY28 onward)
calls.thesis: Platform premium up 49% to INR 1,204 crores and service EBITDA up 89% to INR 39 crores (13% of revenue), but no capacity or supply-side metric; growth is volume and renewal driven.

calls.name: Ugro Capital Ltd
calls.gLine: Closing AUM FY27: flat
calls.thesis: Opex cut to ~INR 119 cr/qtr (from 217) and ~INR 2,551 cr disbursements, but on-book interest income fell 13% QoQ and co-lending/DA income halved to INR 75 cr; capital-cycle reset is real yet earnings quality still in transition.

calls.name: Lumax Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 capex: INR 200-250 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 32.6% to INR 1,223 crore but EBITDA margin flat at 9.2% as OEM commodity recoveries slipped to Q2; FY27 10.5-11% margin guidance and 15-20% growth reiterated, capex raised to INR 200-250 crore.

calls.name: Centum Electronics Ltd
calls.gLine: EMS margin: about 10-11% EBITDA
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue up 11% to INR205 cr with order book ~INR1,800 cr (+31%) and Q1 margin soft at 11.3% EBITDA; overseas exit done, but supply-side evidence is thin and the FY27 25%+ growth target is reiterated without numbers for the quarter.
calls.top: BTS order inflow +150% to INR120 cr

calls.name: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 15% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 22.7% to INR85.2 cr and EBITDA margin up to 10.14% from 7.35%, but growth is export-led; the new Andheri plant adds capacity with domestic sales still mostly unproven.

calls.name: Alicon Castalloy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth (underlying, ex-material): 12% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Alicon's Q1 FY27 revenue crossed Rs 500 crore with 9.5% EBITDA margin (vs 11.4% last year) as aluminium pass-through lags; management guides 12-15% growth and +1% margin, while capacity is ~90-100% utilised and new Rs 125 crore plant adds ~Rs 500 crore revenue by FY30-31.

calls.name: Eveready Industries India Ltd
calls.gLine: Alkaline market share: 25% to 30% exit share in 2 years (2 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR407.7 cr (+9% YoY), EBITDA margin 15.1% on price actions, but alkaline Jammu plant just commissioned and management flags zinc inflation and possible further price/margin corrections.

calls.name: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 realisation: similar to Q1, slight correction (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 on ~80,000t output and ~INR120,000/t realisation, but FY27 volume guidance cut from 400,000t to ~380,000t on transformer and gas-cleaning constraints at KNR-2; Q2 prices guided flat to slightly lower.

calls.name: Jupiter Wagons Ltd
calls.gLine: Wheelset (Odisha) revenue at full commissioning: INR2,500-3,000 crore; EBITDA at least ~15% (FY28 onwards)
calls.thesis: Consolidated revenue up 46% YoY to INR671 crore but EBITDA margin only ~10% and wagon production fell to 1,141 units from 1,347 as the company shifted to new private-wagon designs; order book ~INR4,500 crore.

calls.name: TD Power Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR2,600 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Order inflow INR7.34bn (+87% QoQ) and FY27 guidance raised to INR2,600 crore, but capacity for FY28 is only ~INR22bn plus ~INR0.5bn debottlenecking, with the expansion timing for FY29-30 explicitly left undisclosed.

calls.name: Snowman Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Ankleshwar EXIM start: by end of September (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Snowman's warehousing pricing rose 5-7% and FY27 top-line guided 10-15%, but Q1 rail EBITDA fell on lower double-stacking and imports; management ties recovery to end of West Asia disruption.

calls.name: PDS Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 15% to ₹3,444 cr and EBITDA margin up to 2.8% (from 1.7%), with order book up 23% to ₹6,095 cr, but guidance stays qualitative and the order-book growth is not yet capacity-led.

calls.name: Mobavenue AI Tech Ltd
calls.thesis: AdTech platform reports Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 728m (+56.9% YoY) and PAT margin 16.1%, but no supply-side data; growth is company-driven with limited capacity or pricing disclosure beyond revenue per outcome of Rs 49.94.

calls.name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
calls.gLine: Full-year SSG: high single-digit SSG for balance 9 months (analyst framing, management said 'fair understanding')
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 SSG +3.8% with EBITDA margin 44.6% and store closures accelerated, but management sees competitor store exits in 8 states and guides to a stronger H2 with net positive year; no numeric guidance given.

calls.name: Inox Green Energy Services Ltd
calls.thesis: Inox Green O&M EBITDA of INR57 crore (up 19% YoY) with 96.3% availability, but guidance of INR600 crore annualised EBITDA rests on acquisitions not yet consolidated; INOX Wind pivot to equipment supply leaves Q1 revenue flat and H2 heavy.
calls.top: Wind World India acquisition approved by NCLT

calls.name: Keystone Realtors Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 pre-sales INR 617 cr and collections INR 599 cr (97% efficiency), EBITDA margin 21.3%, but OCF only INR 68 cr against INR 1,000 cr FY guidance; supply-side signals are mainly launch pipeline and land spend.
calls.top: OCF INR 68 cr vs INR 1,000 cr FY guide

calls.name: Netweb Technologies India Ltd
calls.gLine: Order execution cycle: 16 to 20 weeks
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR8,197m (+172% YoY) and PAT margin 10.3%, but inventory days jumped 86→110 and management declined to guide new capex, with a possible enabling resolution for working-capital equity or debt.

calls.name: ASK Automotive Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: high-teens (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +52% headline but only ~25% ex alloy pass-through and wheel-assembly exit; EBITDA Rs 164 cr at 12% margin, capex raised to ~Rs 700 cr with debt rising.

calls.name: INOX India Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow: slightly above INR450-500 cr per quarter (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record INR532 cr order inflow and INR1,686 cr order book, but Q1 revenue of INR382 cr missed the INR410-415 cr target and EBITDA grew only 1.4%; mgmt reiterates 18-20% FY27 growth.

calls.name: EPACK Durable Ltd
calls.gLine: AC industry growth FY27: ~20%, EPACK to outgrow
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~34% to INR886 cr with RAC volume up ~30%, but EBITDA margin fell to 6.21% (6.4% underlying ex-PLI) on forex loss and wage costs; utilisation guided to 55-60% and capex only INR60-70 cr more.

calls.name: Gopal Snacks Ltd
calls.gLine: Sustainable EBITDA margin: 11% to 11.5%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 422.3 cr (+31% YoY) with EBITDA margin 7.4%; management reiterates FY27 EBITDA 8-9% and 20%+ growth, with supply restored after Rajkot restart, but Nagpur utilisation sits below 30%.

calls.name: Standard Engineering Technology Ltd
calls.gLine: Core engineering revenue FY27: ~INR1,200 crores, 40-50% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Record Q1 with revenue up 41% and EBITDA margin 17.5%, but the story is pivoting to unproven AI data-centre and GL Hakko ventures; core order book INR1,400 crores with no capacity or utilisation data disclosed.

calls.name: Raymond Realty Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: minimum 20% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 bookings up 129% to INR700 crore and EBITDA margin 13%, but management is an asset-light JDA-led developer with no capacity or utilisation data; supply-side evidence is absent and interest cost is rising with debt at INR1,095 crore gross.

calls.name: Trualt Bioenergy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 ethanol sales volume: ~44 crore litres (order book)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 ethanol volumes ~8.3-8.5 crore litres on ~60% utilisation with a 44 crore litre FY27 order book, but margins rest on cheap grain inventory that management says will fade at INR25.50/kg maize.
calls.top: Maize at INR25.50 squeezes margin to INR6-7/litre

calls.name: Hexagon Nutrition Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: 20% to 25% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +43% to INR104.3 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 11.3% from 13.8% on raw-material and freight costs; capacity utilisation rose to 47% from ~30%, while inventory days climbed to ~142 from ~130.

calls.name: Dhoot Transmission Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: 25%-30% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue growth near 50% YoY with EBITDA margin up 110bp to 15%, but management guides 15-16% margin only as copper pass-through lags; no capacity-discipline signal beyond 15-20% expansion at two plants.

calls.name: Tempsens Instruments (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth FY27: in line with blended 3-year growth (~27% CAGR cited) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 33% to INR118 crores, but EBITDA margin fell to 22% from 25.3%; management guides growth in line with the 3-year blend and ~INR500 crores of capacity coming online by Q3 FY28, with utilisation at about 80%.

calls.name: Exide Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +17.6% and EBITDA margin 12.4% (+20bp YoY) on broad volume growth; lithium-ion ramp is the main capex story with utilisation guided at 25-30% and Rs1,400 cr FY27 capex approved.

calls.name: RSWM Ltd
calls.gLine: Power & fuel savings FY27: ~₹40 Cr from efforts; ~₹100 Cr target (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 10% QoQ to ₹94 Cr (8.0% margin) on gross margin expansion to 39.8%, with utilisation in the mid-90s for yarn but fabric demand and margins weak and export volumes down.

calls.name: Great Eastern Shipping Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Record quarter on Hormuz-driven tanker spike, but management is holding cash, replacing rather than expanding fleet, and says new orderbook is rising (crude tankers 27%) so supply risk is building.

calls.name: Tilaknagar Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Mid-teens annual volume growth: mid-teens over next couple of years
calls.thesis: Tilaknagar's Q1 FY27 volumes and NSR rose, but EBITDA margin fell to 14.5% adjusted on glass inflation, with net debt rising to Rs 2,100 crore and a March 2027 target of Rs 1,700 crore.

calls.name: Marksans Pharma Ltd
calls.gLine: QliniQ FY27 revenue: INR150-175 crores
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR841 cr (+35.6% YoY) and EBITDA margin 25.3%, but management says gross margin normalises to 55-56% and FY27 guidance is held at 15-20% growth and 20-21% EBITDA margin.

calls.name: Karnataka Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Margin-led beat: NIM 3.20% (vs 3.07% Q4) and CD ratio 78.45% (vs 71.93% a year ago) show balance sheet turning, but management's answers on SMA-2 build-up (INR750 crore) and mid-corporate growth were evasive.

calls.name: Allcargo Logistics Ltd
calls.gLine: Express pre-Ind AS operating PBT margin FY27: 5% to 6%
calls.thesis: Allcargo Q1 FY27 revenue up 11.2% to INR546 cr with Express yield up 6.4% and volume up 6.7%, but the supply side is unchanged: no capacity addition or capex cut, just INR10-15 cr express upkeep and ~INR20 cr CL capex.

calls.name: Lumax Auto Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Mechatronics revenue FY27: around INR 400 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,364 crore (+33% y-o-y) and EBITDA margin 15.1% (+190 bps); management held FY27 guidance and capex at about INR 300 crore, with no explicit capacity-cut or discipline signals.

calls.name: PPAP Automotive Ltd
calls.gLine: Margin recovery: Improvement expected as pass-through settles by end Q2 / early Q3 (Q2-Q3 FY27)
calls.thesis: Revenue up 34.1% to INR156.4 cr and EBITDA up 33.3% to INR12.4 cr, but margins are under raw-material pressure with only ~2% of a ~4% input rise passed through; utilisation is 73%, so no supply discipline signal.

calls.name: Kiri Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper tube plant start: 35 KT operational June 2027 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Dyes realisations drove standalone revenue up 63% to INR 295 cr and material margin to 31.9%, but PAT of INR 270 cr was mostly treasury/other income; copper project remains capital-heavy and pre-revenue.
calls.top: FY28 INR 20,000-25,000 cr revenue guidance dropped

calls.name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd
calls.gLine: US generics growth FY27: mid to high teens (INR) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Alembic Q1 FY27 revenue up 26% to INR2,150 cr with US generics guidance raised to mid-to-high teens, but US branded Pivya drag caps margin near high teens and no capacity additions were discussed.
calls.top: US generics guidance raised to mid-to-high teens

calls.name: Suyog Telematics Ltd
calls.gLine: Total tenancies FY27 exit: 10,000+ tenancies (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR710m (+6.1% y/y on restated basis) with EBITDA margin cut to 59.3% after electricity moved into revenue; growth hinges on Vodafone Idea tenancy loading (150 done, ~700 more, 3,000 FY27 target) with BSNL billing stalled.

calls.name: Vintage Coffee And Beverages Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA margin FY28-29: 23%-24% (FY28-FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR161 cr (+58%) and PAT INR20.8 cr; capacity lifted to 11,000 MT with 4,500 MT running at ~90-95%, but FDC (5,500 MT) commercialisation slips to Q2 FY28 and realisations are quarterly-reset.

calls.name: Minda Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: INR 400-odd crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 1,846 cr (+33% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.5%, but ~INR 106 cr exceptional gain inflates PAT; no capacity-discipline signal, FY27 capex ~INR 400 cr spread across verticals.

calls.name: Satin Creditcare Network Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 reported ROA 3.55% absorbs a INR36 crore management overlay (ex-overlay ~4.34%); credit cost 3.06% reported vs 1.97% ex-overlay, with NIM up to 14.36% and GNPA down to 2.2%.

calls.name: Share India Securities Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue/profit growth: around 20% growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT Rs 124.41 cr (+48% YoY) led by MTF book (~Rs 470 cr) and subsidiaries, but prop still ~52% of profit and management guides ~20% growth with no capacity or supply-side metrics.
calls.top: PMS AUM Rs 150 cr in first quarter

calls.name: MAS Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Direct distribution share: 70% to 72% in 1-1.5 years (1-1.5 years)
calls.thesis: MAS Financial Q1 FY27 shows steady 21% AUM growth and a 25% PAT rise, but credit cost has drifted up to about 1.6% and management is guiding to a wide 1.25–1.75% range rather than a firm number.
calls.top: Eligible demand dipped on energy-linked tightening

calls.name: MSTC Ltd
calls.gLine: TReDS platform operationalisation: Within FY27, subject to RBI approval (FY27)
calls.thesis: MSTC's Q1 FY27 e-commerce revenue rose to Rs 89.49 crore (vs Rs 70.03 crore), but no supply-side capacity signal exists; the asset-light auction platform's growth relies on scrap cycles and unapproved new verticals (EPR, TReDS) awaiting regulatory go-aheads.
calls.top: E-commerce revenue Rs 89.49 cr vs Rs 70.03 cr

calls.name: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 15-16% by FY30 (FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR548.7 crore and EBITDA margin 13.1%, with management targeting 14% by Q4 despite a sharper input-cost hit guided for Q2; no capacity cut, and capex of about INR3,400-3,500 crore is being added.

calls.name: Stove Kraft Ltd
calls.gLine: Induction cooktop share of revenue: at least 20% and a little above
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41.3% to INR480.6 cr and EBITDA margin 11.2% (+71bp), but growth is driven by a demand spike in induction cooktops; management is guiding to a 2x induction year and gross margin up at least 1% YoY with no capacity-discipline evidence.

calls.name: PB Fintech Ltd
calls.gLine: PB Health annual run-rate: ~₹500 Cr, breakeven by Mar'27 (Mar 2027)
calls.thesis: Insurance premium up 41% to ₹8,372 Cr and PAT up 92% to ₹163 Cr, but management openly prioritises fresh-business growth over margin, so no supply-side discipline signal; the read is growth-led and reinvestment-heavy.

calls.name: Eureka Forbes Ltd
calls.gLine: A&SP spend growth: ahead of revenue growth in FY27
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 15.3% to INR701 cr on volume-led water purifier growth, but service bookings softened after 3–12% AMC price hikes and adjusted EBITDA margin fell 46bp to 10.5%.

calls.name: Campus Activewear Ltd
calls.gLine: Volume growth FY27: high single digits (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth of 12.2% rests on pricing and channel-accounting shifts; management is building festive inventory at record production, with volume tapering and no capacity addition signalled beyond ramp-ups.

calls.name: Delhivery Ltd
calls.gLine: Local (intra-city) ARR exit: 250 Cr original target, now 160-175 Cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Delhivery Q1 FY27: revenue ~Rs3,000 Cr (+28% YoY) with PTL yield up to ~Rs12/kg and FY27 guidance narrowed to 20-30% growth, but profitability hit by two new contracts and labour costs; supply-side signals are light.

calls.name: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Incremental cost of borrowing: 8.5%
calls.thesis: Consumer/MSME lender Five-Star Business Finance: Q1 FY27 disbursements record INR 1,496 cr and collections improving, but guidance is on credit cost and gross NPA, with cost-to-asset rising and no supply-side capacity signal.

calls.name: Uniparts India Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: a couple of percentage points above FY26 growth of 21% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR347 crore (+27% YoY), EBITDA INR90 crore (~26% margin); no capacity additions discussed beyond maintenance-type capex of INR12 crore, growth driven by construction and new wins, with FY27 growth guided a few points above FY26's 21%.

calls.name: Capital Small Finance Bank Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 small finance bank with 22% advances growth, NIM up to 4.21% and PAT up 29%, but no supply-side levers; growth is loan-led and profitability gains rely on deposit repricing that management says is largely done.

calls.name: Exicom Tele-Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Consolidated EBITDA breakeven: Q2 FY27 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue +57% to INR237 cr and EBITDA margin 8.8%, but consolidated EBITDA still a INR22 cr loss; capacity expansion is real but Tritium turnaround and Gurgaon-to-Hyderabad transition keep working capital and fixed costs elevated.

calls.name: Suraksha Diagnostic Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: not below 34% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Diagnostics network expanding with 21% revenue growth and 36% EBITDA margin, but growth is volume-led on new centres; no capacity discipline signal, with 100-centre FY28 target and 50-50 new-territory push.
calls.top: New centres under 2 yrs at 6.5% margin

calls.name: Wakefit Innovations Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: Rs 100–120 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Wakefit Q1 FY27 revenue +16.6% to Rs 405 cr with gross margin 57.1%, but management flags ~100 bps gross-margin compression in H1 from raw-material (polyol/TDI) inflation and capex of Rs 100–120 cr is mostly store rollout, not capacity.

calls.name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Ltd
