calls.name: Rathi Steel & Power Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin improvement: 2-3% improvement over two years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes up ~30% to 28,372 MT with TMT doubling, but stainless volumes fell 10-12% and EBITDA margin stays ~4%; utilisation only ~51-52% in FY26, guided >60%.

calls.name: Automotive Axles Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT margin band: 7.5%-8.5% (next few quarters)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin hit 13.6% (vs 12.4% QoQ, 9.7% YoY) on mix and one-offs, while management now sees the industry 5-10% lower for FY27 and capacity was added ahead of a peak Q4.

calls.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
calls.gLine: Market growth: 4% to 5% industry growth; company aims to grow in line with market
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 (June quarter) sales up 23% with EBITDA margin 10.5% vs 8.3%, but management gave no capacity or utilisation number and part of the sales lift is customer inventory build ahead of price rises.

calls.name: Supreme Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume fell ~14% to 1,57,536 t on polymer-driven channel destocking, yet management reiterated 12–13% FY27 volume growth and 14–14.5% EBITDA margin, with July described as "excellent growth".

calls.name: Rico Auto Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: more than INR3,200 crores (~INR3,250 cr) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~39% to INR755 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 4.6% and PAT turned to a INR3.4 cr loss on air freight and aluminium settlement lag; capex being curtailed after 54 projects.

calls.name: Praj Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Praj GenX EBITDA breakeven: by end of FY27
calls.thesis: Praj's Q1 FY27 shows order intake of INR 10 billion and backlog of INR 45.9 billion, but first-gen ethanol greenfield slowdown, funding delays and rising material costs keep conversion and margins weak.

calls.name: PI Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: ETR: around 24% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 17,023 mn, EBITDA margin 22%, export value down 12% on 8% volume decline despite ~13% rupee tailwind; no capacity cut, capex Rs 700-800 cr held, FY27 growth guided low single digit.

calls.name: Xtglobal Infotech Ltd
calls.thesis: Soft IT-services quarter: consolidated revenue +1.1% YoY to ₹93.30 cr, with EBITDA margin up to 7.6% on offshoring mix shift; no supply-side or capex content, and US public-sector and Ireland entry are early-stage.

calls.name: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA: 1.25% plus
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit fell to INR424 crore on higher standard-asset provisions and costlier bulk deposits used to fund competitive corporate lending; management kept FY27 guidance (NIM ~3.5%, GNPA <2.25%) but signals credit growth of 18-20% and a 1.25%+ ROA.

calls.name: Subex Ltd
calls.thesis: Subex Q1 FY27 revenue INR 79.45 cr (+8.9% QoQ, +19.7% YoY) with 21.2% EBITDA margin, but management is signalling margin reinvestment, no numeric guidance, and Middle East order slowdown.

calls.name: PTC India Ltd
calls.gLine: Power demand growth: 4%-6% annually (long term)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume rose 12% to 25.8 BU but standalone PBT fell 32% to Rs 96 crore as surcharge and rebate income shrank on better Discom liquidity; no new long-term contracts expected.
calls.top: Standalone PBT down 32% to Rs 96 cr

calls.name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd
calls.industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)/ Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +12.3% cc YoY with margin 12.4% but a healthcare BPaaS deramp (~1-1.5% of revenue) and INR717m exceptional charges; FY27 guidance held, no capacity signals.

calls.name: PG Electroplast Ltd
calls.gLine: H2/FY27 RAC volume growth: 15-20% for 6 months; ~20%+ full year
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,034 cr (+35%) but operating margin 7.3% under commodity/rupee pressure; management targets ~8% FY27 margin and a compressor line plus 1.2 mn refrigerator plant adds capacity into a tightening import-restricted market.

calls.name: GPT Infraprojects Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: 14% to 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue fell 9% to INR282 crores on West Bengal election labour disruption; management held FY27 30% growth and 14–15% margin guidance, which needs ~INR1,400 crores in the next nine months.

calls.name: NBCC (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Standalone FY27 revenue: INR 13,000-14,000 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Standalone EBITDA up 62% to INR 160 cr (margin 8.77%) on marketing fees, but revenue grew only 10% and order inflow of INR 1,700 cr lags the INR 18,000-20,000 cr targeted for next 2-3 quarters.

calls.name: Orient Cement Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation target: 70% to 75% (medium term)
calls.thesis: Ambuja Cements Q1 FY27 call (filed by Orient): volumes fell (trade -2%, non-trade -21% YoY), ~6.5 Mt of old capacity suspended, cost down INR206/t to INR4,241 but NSP weak and utilisation ~65%.

calls.name: Captain Polyplast Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin trajectory: 10-15 bps blended improvement every quarter as Ahmedabad ramps
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 growth and margin improved (EBITDA +26.7%, margin 12.07%, +99bps) on micro-irrigation volumes and solar pump orders, but polymer costs up 30-35% and working capital is stretched into H2.

calls.name: Dilip Buildcon Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days year-end: about 120
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA margin 10.32% and order inflow only Rs 268 crores; management holds FY27 order guidance of Rs 10,000-12,000 crores and debt cut of Rs 600-800 crores, while standalone net debt rose to Rs 2,106 crores.

calls.name: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd
calls.gLine: IPO listings in current quarter: minimum 3 to 4 (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Capital-markets merchant banker with no quantified Q1 FY27 results, guidance or capacity commentary; mainboard IPO activity slowed sharply versus FY26, and the only numeric outlook is 3-4 IPO listings this quarter.

calls.name: Windlas Biotech Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR248 crores (+18% YoY) with CDMO +29% to INR207 crores, but Trade Generics fell to INR30 crores after codeine exit and management gave no numeric guidance; Plant 6 due end-H1 with ~INR1,100 crores revenue capacity claimed.
calls.top: Trade Generics INR30 crores after codeine exit

calls.name: Venus Pipes & Tubes Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: <17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR320.5 cr but EBITDA margin flat at 16.1%; management guides sub-17% FY27 margin and 18% in two years, with welded utilisation only ~60% and seamless ~85-90%.

calls.name: IKIO Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +41% YoY to Rs169cr and EBITDA margin 13%, but management concedes gross margin fell to ~41% on metals and semiconductor cost/lead-time shocks, and capacity is ahead of demand with only Rs20-25cr capex left.

calls.name: HMA Agro Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue INR 2,072 crore (~90% YoY) and PAT INR 31.9 crore, but no capacity, utilisation or pricing disclosure; growth attributed to buffalo meat exports with unexplained other income surge.

calls.name: Veefin Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Standalone revenue up 128% YoY to Rs 23.14 cr with 55.4% EBITDA margin, but no capacity or supply metrics; pipeline flat at ~$80m after $15.3m conversion and debt-funded working capital raises balance-sheet caution.

calls.name: Redtape Ltd
calls.gLine: New store openings FY27: 150+ stores (aspiration)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 19.4% to INR47 crore on 3.7% standalone revenue growth, driven by no price hikes and retail mix; e-commerce fell to 22% of sales from 30% as management refused deeper discounting.

calls.name: Le Travenues Technology Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 GTV up 19% to Rs 5,524 cr and PAT up 81%, but adjusted EBITDA fell 7% as management reinvests in hotels and AI; flights volume hit by airline capacity cuts.

calls.name: Western Carriers (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex FY27: approx INR100 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 12% to INR465 cr and PAT INR9 cr on domestic volume growth of 37%, but EXIM freight spikes, 111 working-capital days and an unchanged 4.1% EBITDA margin show pricing has not been passed through.
calls.top: EXIM freight 3-4x; no price hike discussed

calls.name: Gaja Alternative Asset Management Ltd
calls.thesis: Asset manager with 100% fee and performance economics; Q1 FY27 PAT up 35% to INR27.2 crore, but performance income (INR29.7 crore) is lumpy and management declined to give forward guidance.

calls.name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
calls.gLine: Own GPU deployment: ~1,500 GPUs by Jan/Feb 2027 (mid-to-end Q4)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7.3% YoY to INR133.66 cr with GPU capacity (Sharon AI, 8,200 B300s) not billing until Q3; the story rests on unproven GPU leasing and heavy customer-advance funding.
calls.top: Sharon AI GPU billing slipped to Q3

calls.name: Tata Elxsi Ltd
calls.gLine: EBIT margin: Sequential ramp toward Q4, no numeric target
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,021 crore, up 6.5% YoY constant currency, but EBIT margin fell 330 bps QoQ on one-offs and onshore ramp costs; management guides to recovery over four quarters without a number.

calls.name: Talbros Automotive Components Ltd
calls.gLine: Exports share FY28: 35%
calls.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue of INR242 crore (+15% YoY) and EBITDA margin 17.6%, but supply-side evidence is thin: no capacity-discipline signal, margin pressure from steel/aluminium and wages, and forging guidance cut from ~INR400 crore to ~INR340 crore.
calls.top: Forging FY27 revenue cut to ~INR340 crore

calls.name: Eldeco Housing & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Legacy inventory liquidation FY27: 40% to 60% of ~INR 75 cr
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 profit spike driven by one horizontal project (Imperia Phase 2, ~60% gross margin on 85% of revenue); bookings fell to INR 105.7 cr with no supply-discipline evidence, and FY28 guidance is only qualitative.

calls.name: Vaibhav Global Ltd
calls.gLine: FY30 revenue: INR5,000-5,500 crore
calls.thesis: Reported growth flattered by INR25 crore US tariff refund and FX; constant-currency revenue broadly flat, with Q1 EBITDA margin 11% helped by one-off. FY27 guidance of 9-11% reiterated.

calls.name: Transport Corporation of India Ltd
calls.gLine: Seaways EBITDA margin Q2: 25-30% (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up ~9% with standalone ~7% and EBITDA margins flat; supply-chain growth slowed, Seaways bunker costs compress margins, and guidance (10-12% freight, 12-15% supply chain) rests on H2 pipeline.

calls.name: Welspun Enterprises Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR8,000 crore to INR10,000 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue soft at INR774 crore on execution delays, with 22.9% EBITDA margin and INR1,800 crore cash; management targets about 15% growth, closer to 15% than 20%, and order book slipped to INR18,700 crore.
calls.top: Q1 revenue soft; order book declined

calls.name: V2 Retail Ltd
calls.thesis: V2 Retail grew revenue 58% to INR997 cr with SSSG about 7.5% and 56 net stores added, but gross margin fell to 28.6% and management is pushing 4-5% price hikes from Q3 with 170-200 store openings still planned.

calls.name: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Ltd
calls.gLine: Park additions: about one park every year; 12 parks by 2030 (FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +20% to INR178 cr and EBITDA +24% to INR90 cr, but ARPU flat near INR1,395 and management admits softer ticket pricing to buy footfall; supply additions (Indore, Mehsana, Hello Park) are growing capacity alongside.

calls.name: Inox Wind Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹872 cr with flat YoY growth as Inox Wind pivots from turnkey EPC to equipment supply; management reiterates 75% FY27 revenue growth and 20–22% EBITDA margin, H2-loaded, with little Q1 evidence.

calls.name: Best Agrolife Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin (FY27, indicative): 13%-14% sustainable
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA rose 70% to Rs 78 cr (20% margin) on mix and pricing, but revenue grew only 4% and management withdrew near-term growth guidance, with capex on hold and ~Rs 60 cr sales-return provision.

calls.name: Mitsu Chem Plast Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue growth: Quarter-on-quarter growth similar to recent quarters (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin jumped to 16.29% (from 5.87%) on mix and efficiency, but management still guides 10–12% sustainable; utilisation 64% in FY26 while a 3,550 MTPA expansion is announced, with cost pass-through of raw materials.

calls.name: Indian Energy Exchange Ltd
calls.gLine: RTM volume growth: 25-30% CAGR (CEO gut feel) (medium term)
calls.thesis: IEX Q1 FY27 volume rose 16% to 37.5 BU and PAT 134.8 crore (+12%), but the Grid India market-coupling order threatens the core DAM franchise and management gave no timeline.

calls.name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd
calls.gLine: Non-convenience fee: return to INR150 crore per quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.1% to INR1,370 crore led by catering (+34%), but EBITDA fell 2.8% to INR386 crore and margin dipped to 28.2% on one-offs, HR cost and a 30% resin-driven squeeze in Rail Neer; no supply-side capacity signal from IRCTC itself.

calls.name: Chemplast Sanmar Ltd
calls.gLine: PVC-VCM spread: EBITDA neutral at $120-130; PBT positive another $20-30
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA loss of INR115 crores on high-cost VCM; management sees PVC-VCM spread near $160 from September but gave no numeric profitability guidance, with CMCD order book and R32 ramp as offsets.

calls.name: Senco Gold Ltd
calls.gLine: New stores: 12-15 more in FY27 (remainder FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 67% with retail +50% and SSSG ~39%, but reported EBITDA fell to 7.0% (from 10.1%) and management retained 7.5-7.8% guidance; supply-side signals (inventory days ~152, hedging held at ~50%) are mixed.

calls.name: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA INR79.3 crores at 19.3% margin with Dombivli drag INR9.5 crores; occupancy diluted to 59.6% by new beds, guidance on Dombivli loss held at INR2-3 crores per month with no raise.
calls.top: Occupancy diluted to 59.6% by Dombivli beds

calls.name: Vikran Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue from operations: INR2,300–2,500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 standalone revenue INR204 cr (+28%) with consolidated revenue only INR141.6 cr after NOPL consolidation; H2-weighted FY27 guide of INR2,300–2,500 cr and receivables (debtor days ~296) remain the key unproven items.

calls.name: Banswara Syntex Ltd
calls.gLine: Garment revenue run-rate: about INR100 crore per quarter for next 3 quarters
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 4% with yarn utilisation at 70% and garment dispatches slipped; management holds FY27 INR1,450-1,500 crore guidance and a 12% EBITDA target, with INR140 crore capex sanctioned, while Q1 consolidated EBITDA was 9%.

calls.name: Premier Explosives Ltd
calls.gLine: Export revenue Q2: INR150-200 crores (Q2 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 28% to INR102.6 cr and EBIT margin to 4.7% on export and import delays; order book INR1,393 cr (94% defence) and FY27 INR600 cr target rests on export licences arriving, with no new capacity capex quantified.

calls.name: Nucleus Software Exports Ltd
calls.thesis: Order book rose to INR 1,244 crore (from 1,044) but Q1 revenue only INR 210.4 crore (+3.4% YoY) and EBITDA margin collapsed to 3.6%, with DSO up to 63 days.

calls.name: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd
calls.gLine: Brand-building spend FY27: INR 85 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +19.5% on volume, but EBITDA margin fell to 10.1% (vs 13.1%); management attributes ~4.35pts to one-offs and reiterates 13.5–14% FY27 margin and 18–20% growth, with sanitaryware utilisation at just 61%.

calls.name: Gallantt Ispat Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA Rs203 cr (18% margin, Rs8,787/t) flat QoQ but down YoY on pellet shutdown and coal; 0.23 mt expansion guided H2 FY27, mines FY28, no supply cut or deferral.
calls.top: TMT prices corrected sharply in Q1

calls.name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: Ethnic portfolio revenue growth FY27: 20% plus (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,026 cr (+11%) and EBITDA margin 8.2%, with TCNS like-to-like only ~2% and a sizeable TMRW loss; no capacity or supply-side signal, and cost inflation of ~4% is flagged to hit Q2–Q3 margins.

calls.name: Ceinsys Tech Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue flat at INR158 crore (+1% YoY) with margin up to 24.4%; order book INR990 crore but management refused all forward guidance and UBR/cash conversion remains weak (164-day working capital cycle).

calls.name: S Chand and Company Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs1,145m (+12% YoY) with EBITDA loss Rs97m; management reiterated 10–15% growth and 17–19% EBITDA margin guidance, while stockpiling ~25% of annual paper needs ahead of price rises, lifting working capital.

calls.name: IFGL Refractories Ltd
calls.gLine: Hofmann Ceramic losses: breakeven by end FY27
calls.thesis: Standalone EBITDA fell 17% YoY to INR31 crore as gross margin slid to 43% from 47% on raw material and LPG costs; consolidated EBITDA flat at INR40 crore, with price hikes only partly recovering input costs.

calls.name: Zim Laboratories Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth without EU-GMP: 10-15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 3.7% on ₹942m revenue (+31% YoY) with a loss after tax; growth hinges on an EU-GMP final report still pending, with management guiding FY28 +30-35% only if EU approval lands.

calls.name: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1FY27 PAT ₹143 cr (+23% YoY) and ROE 17.5% held, but Stage 3 rose to 1.5% and management guides only a Q3 turn; disbursement cut to ₹641 cr by a one-time recognition change.

calls.name: Allied Blenders and Distillers Ltd
calls.gLine: Margin benefit from backward integration: ~300bp by FY28, further 100bp by FY29 (FY28-FY29)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume +6.2% and gross margin +277bp to 46%, but reported EBITDA flat at ₹120cr due to ₹24cr supply-chain hit; FY27 margin guided flat to FY26 with price hikes only hoped for, not confirmed.
calls.top: Margin guide FY27 flat to FY26

calls.name: Brainbees Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross margin recovery: fully recover crude/rupee pass-through by end of Q2
calls.thesis: India multi-channel revenue grew 17.7% but gross margin fell 280 bps in Q4 and recovered only 20 bps in Q1, with diapering price competition and crude-linked pass-through driving the squeeze; consolidated adj. EBITDA margin fell to 4.24% from 4.98%.
calls.top: India gross margin down 280 bps in Q4

calls.name: Mach Travel Solutions Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR144.33 cr (+538% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 6.09% from 7.17%, management admits markup cuts for aggressive market share and working-capital strain requires bank OD.
calls.top: Working capital strain, bank OD being sought

calls.name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross block by end FY27: approximately double current (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR108 cr (+71% YoY) with 58% plant utilisation, yet management is pulling capex forward and gross block to double by FY27 on Saudi JV, aerospace qualifications and Hobel; supply is expanding ahead of confirmed demand.
calls.top: Capex pulled forward; gross block ~2x by FY27

calls.name: Excelsoft Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR350-360 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR802.63m with EBITDA margin down to 16.24% from 18.02%; management guides 24-25% FY27 EBITDA margin, a cut from the earlier ~30% view, and FY27 revenue of INR350-360 crore.

calls.name: Park Medi World Ltd
calls.gLine: Revenue FY27: Rs.2,080 crores (+24%) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Capacity is ramping to 4,740 beds by FY27 and 5,740 by FY28 while occupancy fell to 56% from 68%, so supply is outrunning demand; FY27 guidance of 24% revenue growth and ARPOB +10-12% is management's case.

calls.name: Laser Power & Infra Ltd
calls.gLine: Interest saving on debt repayment: ~INR40 crore per year at PBT level
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +15% to INR5,215m and EBITDA +26% to INR659m, but finance cost absorbed 55% of EBITDA; capacity utilisation cited at 62% (manufacturing), with no new capex guidance and a stated focus on utilisation.

calls.name: Purple Style Labs Ltd
calls.thesis: Luxury omni-channel retailer in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA at negative INR11 crores vs negative INR4 crores a year ago, PAT loss INR88 crores, and debt rising to INR436 crores despite inventory falling to INR159 crores.

calls.name: ACC Ltd
calls.thesis: Ambuja cut low-margin non-trade volume (trade -2%, non-trade -21% YoY, total -7%) to chase value; net cost fell to INR4,241/t and FY27 cost target INR4,250 held, but utilisation is ~65%.

calls.name: GMM Pfaudler Ltd
calls.gLine: Debt repayment: EUR 7 million by end Q2 FY27; 12-18 months for further reduction
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% to INR 925 crore but EBITDA down 7% YoY to INR 94 crore on pricing pressure and organisation investment; no capacity signals, margin recovery deferred with no numeric timeline.

calls.name: Styrenix Performance Materials Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin spike (EBITDA margin 26.1%) came from a transient pricing gap while volumes fell ~26% YoY; management refused to give volume or margin guidance and called Q1 margins non-sustainable.

calls.name: Virat Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Lord Walker domestic volume: approximately 1 million pairs in calendar 2027 (CY2027)
calls.thesis: Investor-meet call is mostly promoter-led diversification into a Brahm lifestyle platform via Rs95 cr primary investment; socks pricing up to Rs63/pair but no capacity, utilisation or capex disclosure, and forecasts are unsupported.
calls.top: Rs95 cr primary investment in lifestyle unit

calls.name: Patel Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: ~10% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 24.5% to Rs 93.5 cr on 4% revenue growth, mostly from lower finance costs; order book Rs 14,636 cr (~3x book-to-bill) with FY27 growth guided at ~10%, but no capacity or capex discussion.

calls.name: Birlasoft Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 effective tax rate: 29% to 30%
calls.thesis: Birlasoft Q1 FY27 revenue flat in USD ($145.2M, +0.3% cc QoQ) with TCV up 20% YoY to $168.7M, but management refused any numeric guidance and pricing pressure is squeezing revenue conversion.

calls.name: AIA Engineering Ltd
calls.gLine: Capex: INR350-400 crore FY27 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume 64,644 t (vs ~60,000 a year ago) with no guidance on FY27 volume; management held status quo on tonnage, margin and realisation while capex guidance was raised to INR350-400 crore.

calls.name: Kuantum Papers Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak debt: INR760-770 crore max; under INR300 crore in 3 years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA flat at INR40 crore (13.2% margin) as cost rose INR4,200/t against NSR gain of INR3,400/t; guidance trimmed to INR1,300 crore+ revenue, with EBITDA margin target 16-18% pushed to year-end.
calls.top: FY27 revenue cut to INR1,300 crore+

calls.name: Emerald Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Borrowing cost / debt capacity: Rs 63 Cr additional debt capacity (current)
calls.thesis: Small NBFC pivoting to Early Wage Access; Q1 PAT Rs 4.88 Cr (+52.7% YoY) but gold-loan distribution fell and EPS 7 guidance needs ~66% PAT growth, with corporate onboarding slowing to ~30 per quarter.
calls.top: Gold loan distribution Q4 375 → Q1 290 Cr

calls.name: AvenuesAI Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 consolidated revenue: INR 11,000 to 13,000 crores (~35%+ growth) (FY27)
calls.thesis: Payments-to-AI-fintech pivot: gross revenue up 109% but net revenue down 3% on take-rate compression, with EBITDA margin gains driven by expense cuts and FY27 EPS guided flat at INR 8.75–9.5 as incremental cash is reinvested into AI.
calls.top: Take rates compressed; net revenue down 3%

calls.name: Prime Fresh Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin: 7% to 7.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 sales up 15.7% to INR81.71 crores and EBITDA margin 9.83%, but management itself flagged one-offs, guides EBITDA 7-7.5%, and receivables are about a third of sales with INR7-8 crore slow-moving debtors.

calls.name: Happiest Minds Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14.3% YoY in rupees but only 6.7% in constant currency; margin flat at 17.5% reported, with management still targeting 12.5% FY27 growth needing ~5% QoQ CAGR in remaining quarters.
calls.top: Merger: HM into ITC Infotech, 15-month timeline

calls.name: Tarsons Products Ltd
calls.gLine: Panchla/Amta contribution to standalone revenue FY28: 20-25% of standalone revenue (FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +21% YoY to Rs 86 cr standalone with gross margin down to 67.1% on 25-50% input cost spikes; capacity still commissioning with debt at Rs 380 cr gross and no major capex planned.

calls.name: C.E. Info Systems Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 14.9% to INR139.7 cr with 40.2% EBITDA margin, but Map-led flat (INR98.2→98.7 cr) and growth came from IoT hardware; no supply-side data, and receivables/write-off and order-book visibility remain the watch points.

calls.name: Network People Services Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: International revenue share: around 50% in about 2 years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue about INR 61.4 crore, down quarter-on-quarter from about INR 68 crore, yet management reiterated 60-70% annual growth and about 30% EBITDA margin with no numbers on supply or capex.
calls.top: Q1 revenue down QoQ to INR 61.42 crore

calls.name: Indogulf Cropsciences Ltd
calls.gLine: Peak revenue with existing capacity: Rs 1100-1200 crore
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 11% YoY to Rs 168.5 cr on monsoon-delayed demand and price pressure, while gross margin rose to 28% from 22%; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and finance costs rose ~19%.
calls.top: Prices under pressure, China supply elevated

calls.name: Highway Infrastructure Ltd

calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 4% to INR 6,776m and EBITDA to INR 600m on a deferred order; management guides single-digit FY27 growth, with capacity utilisation and capex not discussed.

calls.name: Sky Gold And Diamonds Ltd
calls.gLine: Advance Gold share: 15% FY27, 20% FY28, 25% FY29, 30% FY30 (FY27-FY30)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR2,013 cr (+78% YoY) and gross margin 9.3%, but utilisation is only ~55-60% with capacity added only after 2028, and management declined to revise FY27 guidance until after Diwali.

calls.name: Affle 3I Ltd
calls.gLine: Larger M&A closing: early 2027 (early 2027)
calls.thesis: Affle Q1 FY27 revenue up 20.4% y-o-y to INR 7.47bn with EBITDA margin flat at 22.4%; no capacity signals, and management guides ~20% organic growth with a large M&A targeted for early 2027.

calls.name: Antony Waste Handling Cell Ltd
calls.gLine: Labour cost % revenue: normalise to 30-31% in next 3 quarters
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell 27% YoY to ₹45 crore (16.8% margin vs 24.4%) on labour, transport and one-off disposal costs; WtE plant down until October, with ₹22-24 crore impairment flagged.

calls.name: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd
calls.gLine: Deposit growth: 18% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 total business up 23% to ₹1,21,715 cr and record net profit ₹412 cr, but growth is gold-led and funded by term deposits, with CASA down 2.95% QoQ and FY guidance raised.

calls.name: Stanley Lifestyles Ltd
calls.gLine: Same-store growth for mature stores: 15% to 20% YoY (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR 9,935 lakhs from 10,861 (about -8.5%) on B2B freight disruption and delayed residential handovers; utilisation 68-70% and store network being reshaped, with no capacity addition signalled.

calls.name: Jungle Camps India Ltd
calls.gLine: Mathura hotel opening: FY28 (FY28)
calls.thesis: Small wildlife-camp operator with flat-ish ADR (+5% YoY) and occupancy 45% in Q1 FY27; EBITDA fell to 27% from 32% and growth depends on debt-funded Mathura and Sheopur projects, a weak supply-side signal.
calls.top: New capacity debt-funded: ₹32 cr HDFC loan

calls.name: Laxmi India Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: ROA: 3.5% to 3.75% target (end of FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 NBFC print strong on margin (NIM 11.36%, cost of borrowing 10.66%) but credit cost rose to 0.95% from 0.58%, driven by vehicle finance and a 10% extra provision on up-money cases; PAT +70% YoY.

calls.name: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd
calls.thesis: Ayurveda hospital and products operator reports 29% YoY revenue growth and 41% EBITDA margin, but management's answers were evasive on the revenue-to-volume gap, with ~INR14cr other income and ~INR7cr one-offs flattering PAT.

calls.name: Gem Aromatics Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 3.3% and PAT was a Rs7.9 cr loss as new Dahej capacity sits idle ahead of commercial ramp; management gave no FY27 numbers, deferring guidance to calendar year-end.
calls.top: Dahej capex ~Rs265 cr of Rs270 cr capitalised

calls.name: Capillary Technologies India Ltd
calls.gLine: Organic growth FY27: ~17% full-year organic after ~6% FX (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR256 crore (+43% reported, ~17% organic, ~6% FX) and adjusted EBITDA INR44 crore (~17%); no capacity or capex signal, so the read rests on NRR 111%, new ACV and margin mix.

calls.name: Sonata Software Ltd
calls.gLine: International EBITDA trajectory: positive traction every quarter this year (FY27)
calls.thesis: Sonata's international utilisation fell to 88.5% from 91.8% and EBITDA to 15.4% from 20.2%, with management giving no quantified margin or growth guidance and no capacity signal, leaving the Q2 recovery unproven.

calls.name: Strides Pharma Science Ltd
calls.gLine: Product launches: about 10 launches by 31 March 2027 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% with Ex-US up 17% but Ex-US sequentially down to $63m from $70m on shipment delays; US flat, FY28 $375m target reliant on unapproved launches and quota-limited controlled substances (~5% of revenue).

calls.name: Moneyboxx Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM target: INR1,600-1,700 crores for profitability inflection (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 MFI-to-secured pivot: disbursements fell to INR77 crores from INR92 crores, NIM fell to 12.3% from 14.36%, and PAT was INR0.21 crores, with a Q4 FY27 normalisation promised but unproven.

calls.name: Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 turnover: Rs 1,250 cr, possibly Rs 1,350-1,400 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 10% to Rs 280 cr on 25% lower chemical volumes and fertiliser volume down 13%; management guides FY27 Rs 1,250 cr (possibly 1,350-1,400) while Unit 5/6 capacity is added and acid plants are run at low load.

calls.name: Afcons Infrastructure Ltd
calls.gLine: Gross debt FY27: close to INR3,500 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell ~20% YoY to INR2,727 cr and PAT to INR30 cr on stalled work fronts and stretched client payments; management gave no numeric revenue guidance, only a debt and capex target.

calls.name: Enviro Infra Engineers Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR359 crore (+49% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 21.07% from 26.65%, and management cut FY27 margin guidance to 21-22% while working capital remains "bloated"; no capacity-discipline signal.

calls.name: Ion Exchange India Ltd
calls.gLine: Specialty chemicals capacity: At least 50% increase over next couple of years
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA fell 49% YoY to INR 32 crore (4.54% margin) as Treatment Solutions stayed loss-making on legacy UP project; Roha capacity ramp is slower than the 25% first-year utilisation guided.

calls.name: Transpek Industry Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth: at least 15% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 6.5% to INR155.1 cr and EBITDA fell 32.4% to INR24.1 cr (15.6% margin); management guides ~15% FY27 revenue growth and a INR250 cr Odisha/pilot capex plan, with the key DuPont/Arclin contract renewal unresolved.

calls.name: Foods & Inns Ltd
calls.gLine: Frozen segment revenue: USD30-plus million in 3 years; 20%-plus growth this year (3 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 exports slowed by vessel shortage and freight spikes with delayed call-offs but no cancellations; frozen segment grew about 20% in Q1 and management sees domestic volume growth of 20%.

calls.name: Aarti Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA of Rs 385 cr (+79% YoY) was flattered by inventory and FX gains (guided Rs 50-60 cr), volumes fell 12% QoQ, and management declined to hold the run rate; Zone IV ramp is delayed.

calls.name: ZEN Technologies Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to Rs141.6 Cr (down 11% YoY) and order book net-shrank to Rs1,239 Cr; management blames demand timing, with simulator tenders still pending and no capacity signals.

calls.name: Yatra Online Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gross bookings up 17% to INR21,007m but adjusted EBITDA fell 39% to INR151m (12.3% of gross margin) on MICE disruption and Kanoo cost build; management gives no FY27 guidance and expects only a H2 recovery.

calls.name: Crizac Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 4% YoY to INR2,012m on a less favourable university mix despite enrolments up 15%; management now guides FY27 flat with FY26 after Q2 hit, versus earlier 15-17% growth view.

calls.name: Tata Chemicals Ltd
calls.gLine: India sustainable EBITDA margin: ~18%
calls.thesis: Soda ash oversupply (China inventory at record 1.73 mn mt) keeps export margins at breakeven; India EBITDA margin of ~28% flattered by coal inventory and throttled soda ash output, management sees ~18% sustainable, capex capped near depreciation (~INR 1,200 cr).
calls.top: China soda ash inventory all-time high 1.73 mn mt

calls.name: Hester Biosciences Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone growth of 14% and 88% PAT rise, but consolidated revenue fell 8% on Nepal and Africa, and management gave no numeric guidance; utilisation is about 60-65%, so no capacity discipline signal.

calls.name: Aurionpro Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: R&D expense as % of revenue: 10.5% to 11% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 358 cr (+6.3% YoY) with EBITDA margin 17% and no FY guidance; management blames MEA disruption, capacity diverted to product build-outs, and data-centre ramp timing, with conversion expected to improve from Q2 and accelerate in H2.
calls.top: No FY27 revenue or margin guidance

calls.name: Insecticides (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Granuvia FY27 sales: ~INR20 crore gross
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 12% to INR612 cr on a 13% volume decline; gross margin rose to 31.6% but EBITDA margin fell to 11.1%, with June inventory elevated and no major price hikes sticking.

calls.name: Jyothy Labs Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue growth excluding Pril and FA: double-digit
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 gross margin fell 950bp to 38.5% and EBITDA margin to 8.4% as crude-linked input inflation outran ~3% price hikes; management guides H2 better than H1 but gives no margin number.

calls.name: Gravita India Ltd
calls.gLine: Copper capacity: double to ~60,000 MTPA in 3 years (3 years)
calls.thesis: Lead volumes fell YoY as Gulf supply disruption stranded scrap and utilisation near 50% on expanded capacity; margins held via pricing, copper 50% utilised and ramping only slowly.
calls.top: Lead volumes down YoY on Gulf scrap disruption

calls.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
calls.gLine: OSAT + PCB FY27 revenue: INR450-500 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR946 crore (+40% YoY) and EBITDA margin 15.6%, but operating cash flow was negative INR259 crore on inventory build of ~INR177 crore and metering receivables rising to INR1,311 crore; margin pressure flagged as a multi-quarter issue.

calls.name: Patel Retail Ltd
calls.gLine: New stores FY27: 8 to 10 stores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to about 6.3% from prior levels on raw-material mix, with capacity utilisation only 50–55% and a 24-month store payback; supply discipline is not evidenced.

calls.name: Vikram Solar Ltd
calls.gLine: DCR volume growth: 2 to 2.5x every quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume record 1,006 MW but EBITDA margin fell to 8.06% (INR1.25/W) as non-DCR pricing failed to pass through costs; management withdrew FY27 guidance pending H1 results.

calls.name: Kusumgar Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA margin FY27: similar to FY25-FY26 levels, moving a few percentage points (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR247.2 cr (+102% YoY, -21% QoQ) with management declining formal guidance and order-book disclosure; utilisation only 55-60% with no large capex planned, so supply is not yet a constraint.

calls.name: Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Kharsang gas pipeline: 24 km, completion by December next year (Dec 2027)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue rebounded to INR117.5 cr standalone on Kharsang volumes and $95.5/bbl realisation, but B-80 output is down on water cut, HPCL crude stuck and funding for the three-well B-80 programme depends on raising debt.

calls.name: Onida Electronics Ltd
calls.thesis: Consumer electronics turnaround with Q1 revenue up 29.5% to Rs 182.4 cr but loss widened to Rs 14.2 cr; no numeric guidance, capacity being scaled down and management calls the balance sheet "slightly stressed".
calls.top: Washing machine margins hit by competition

calls.name: PTC India Financial Services Ltd
calls.gLine: AUM by end FY27: around INR 5,000 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursement just INR 117 crore with loan book INR 2,946 crore and Stage III INR 190 crore, 187 crore in one NCLT account; growth recovery is promised but not yet evidenced.

calls.name: Rupa & Company Ltd
calls.gLine: Athleisure growth FY27: more than double-digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +10.1% to Rs 202.4 cr on volume, but price hikes of 4-5% were passed on as schemes; EBITDA margin 7.8% missed the prior 9-10% guide, with guidance reiterated at 9-10% for next quarter.
calls.top: Q1 price hike 4-5% passed to trade

calls.name: TeamLease Services Ltd
calls.gLine: Staffing EBITDA margin: Flat for Q1-Q2, expansion from Q3-Q4 (FY27)
calls.thesis: Staffing volume growth has slowed to mid-single digits with business EBITDA up 18% YoY but group EBITDA only up 3% on higher corporate cost; management guided no EBITDA margin expansion until Q3 and dropped FY27 20% EBITDA growth confidence.

calls.name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 16% against 20-30% expected, PAT down to INR95 crore from INR111 crore as depreciation and interest hit before IPP revenue ramps; margins under geopolitical cost pressure at KP Energy.
calls.top: PAT margin FY27 guide to be lower

calls.name: Global Surfaces Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 65 crore (+44%) with EBITDA Rs 8 crore, but utilisation only 27% and management gave no numeric guidance, so the recovery rests on cost cuts and a Dubai shipping reopening.

calls.name: Credo Brands Marketing Ltd
calls.gLine: Same-store revenue growth FY27: mid-single-digit
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 5% to INR125.3 cr with EBITDA margin down to 21.2% and PAT 1.8%, as marketing rose to 8.5% of revenue; management gave no numeric growth visibility beyond the next few quarters.

calls.name: Digitide Solutions Ltd
calls.gLine: Normalised quarterly D&A: INR55-57 cr per quarter
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR775 cr (+5.3% YoY, -3.1% QoQ), EBITDA margin 9.9% with TCV down to INR205 cr; management self-selecting out of low-margin accounts and targeting 200 bps margin expansion in FY27.

calls.name: Anlon Healthcare Ltd
calls.gLine: PAT margin FY27 and FY28: 12-13% (FY27-FY28)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to about 17% on raw-material spikes and Remember India consolidation, with management guiding 25-27% for FY27 and FY27 revenue of 350-400 crore, unverified against an 87.6 crore first quarter.

calls.name: Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd_DVR
calls.gLine: Hi-Tech revenue growth FY27: double digit (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue about flat near Rs 1,500 crore but EBITDA fell on lost fixed-cost absorption; NCD repayments of about Rs 680 crore due in FY27 hinge on refinancing and internal accruals.

calls.name: Oriental Aromatics Ltd
calls.gLine: Sales growth: 10% to 15% in next one year (next one year)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volumes +22% YoY but revenue only +15% and EBITDA margin 7.62% (below 8.01% a year ago); Mahad at 50-60% utilisation with unsold inventory building, and management gave no margin or Mahad timeline.

calls.name: Shilchar Technologies Ltd
calls.gLine: Q2 business momentum: notably better than Q1
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 134.6 cr and EBITDA Rs 29.2 cr hit by West Asia shipping costs and delayed pass-through; utilisation only 60-65% in Q1, with 7,500 MVA existing capacity guided to near-full use and Phase-3 (6,500 MVA) on track for April 2027.

calls.name: Linc Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 margins squeezed by polymer costs (EBITDA margin 8.7%, down 89 bps YoY) with management withholding all guidance and pricing only ~50% passed through; no capacity or capex signals.

calls.name: Ashoka Buildcon Ltd
calls.gLine: Order inflow FY27: INR6,000 to 8,000 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue flat at INR1,320 crores, FY27 growth guide cut from 20% to 10-15% and margin guide cut 0.5pt, with domestic highway awarding muted and order book INR15,251 crores.

calls.name: Krsnaa Diagnostics Ltd
calls.gLine: EBITDA positive: Q2 FY27
calls.thesis: Krsnaa Q1 FY27 revenue up 22% to INR2,355m but EBITDA margin fell to 25% from 27% on Rajasthan ramp costs; management guides EBITDA-positive by Q2 with no hard numeric margin guidance, and receivables from Himachal and Karnataka remain uncollected.

calls.name: Epigral Ltd
calls.gLine: Long-term growth: 15% to 20% CAGR over 3-5 years (3-5 years)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +15% to INR709cr and EBITDA margin 25% (vs 27%), but chlor-alkali ECU fell to ~INR31-32k from INR35-36k and CPVC utilisation ~50-55% with new CPVC capacity coming, while management adds epoxy and MPP capex of INR600cr.

calls.name: Godawari Power and Ispat Ltd
calls.gLine: Captive ore full use: 100% captive in FY28
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 pellet plant shut on gas cost up 40-45% and merchant ore buying; Q2 pellet output guided ~500 kt, mining ramp deferred to Q3-Q4, steel plant put on hold.

calls.name: Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd
calls.gLine: ICONIQA annualised revenue break-even: ~INR 85 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 36% to ~INR 107 cr and EBITDA margin ~30.7%, but PAT fell to ~INR 6.4 cr from 10.9 cr; management concedes profit is flat and ICONIQA break-even needs ~INR 85 cr annualised revenue.

calls.name: Blue Star Ltd
calls.gLine: Segment II EBIT margin FY27: over 6.5% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Blue Star's RAC segment margin fell to 2.9% in Q1 as it held share by discounting; management guides Segment II margin above 6.5% for FY27 while cutting pass-through to 5% of an intended 13%.

calls.name: BCL Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Distillery and overall EBITDA margin: around 10% - 12%
calls.thesis: Distillery margin rose to 12.41% but ENA realisation fell to INR58/l from INR70 on oversupply, with the 200 KLPD plant shut after a fire and the 250 KLPD Fatehabad expansion put on hold.

calls.name: Jai Balaji Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Ferroalloy capacity utilisation: 80% to 90%
calls.thesis: DI pipe utilisation only ~30% on 5.5 lakh TPA with prices down 25-30% and no volume guidance, while ferroalloy utilisation above 80% and capacity expanding to 1.9 lakh MT, to be commissioned by Q3 FY27.
calls.top: DI pipe utilisation ~30% on enhanced capacity

calls.name: Oswal Pumps Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 operating EBITDA margin: 15% to 17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 7.9% YoY to INR474 crore and operating EBITDA margin fell to 15.7% on Magel Tyala price cuts of 9%; receivable days jumped to 229 and FY27 growth of 20-25% rests on PM KUSUM 2.0 timing.

calls.name: AJC Jewel Manufacturers Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 standalone India revenue: Rs 450 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 125% to Rs 101.4 cr with EBITDA margin 4.6%, but management gave no utilisation or capex-cut discipline, Kerala capacity being expanded to 120% while utilisation is ~25%, and CFO has been negative for six years.

calls.name: Saatvik Green Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: Cell ramp-up / utilisation: about 80% utilisation by Q4 FY27 (Q4 FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 volume collapsed to 334 MW sales (from 1,050 MW in Q4) and EBITDA fell to INR 425 mn; capex of ~INR 1,000 mn spent with cell ramp only from Sept, so supply discipline is offset by weak utilisation and no cell output until late FY27.

calls.name: Dhanuka Agritech Ltd
calls.gLine: Dahej FY27 revenue: Rs 65 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 12.56% to Rs 461.93 cr on weak monsoon and price reversal; management cut FY27 guidance to small single-digit growth and no supply cut, with Rs 200 cr Nagpur plant adding capacity.
calls.top: FY27 guidance cut to single-digit growth

calls.name: KNR Constructions Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 revenue: INR2,200–2,300 crore (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA of 15% was flattered by a one-off ~INR46 crore cash-surplus claim; ex-one-off margin ~5.5%, with receivables stretched (Telangana ~INR1,300 crore) and FY27 revenue guided INR2,200–2,300 crore.

calls.name: ECOS (India) Mobility & Hospitality Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 10.3% (from 12.0% a year ago) on ETS price competition; FY27 margin guidance cut to around 10% from 11–13%, while revenue guidance held at 15–18%.

calls.name: Jinkushal Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue up 15.9% to INR56.57 cr but PAT fell to INR2.2 cr from INR6.51 cr, with INR96.8 cr inventory (INR84.4 cr overseas) and no supply discipline signal, so this is a cash-stretched growth read.
calls.top: Inventory INR96.8 cr, INR84.4 cr overseas

calls.name: Som Distilleries & Breweries Ltd
calls.gLine: Andhra Pradesh go-live: first week of September
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 was a disrupted quarter: MP brewery suspended ~6 months, ~INR250-260 crore revenue lost, EBITDA INR15.2 crore; UP brewery (10m cases) commissioned but management guides FY27 revenue down to INR1,000-1,100 crore.

calls.name: Navneet Education Ltd
calls.gLine: Domestic Stationery revenue growth FY27: 15-17% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue slipped to Rs 785 cr on late state textbook release; management guides Publication growth ~10% and Export Stationery -5%, with 26% domestic stationery growth offset by a 30%-utilised polymer plant and margin pressure.

calls.name: Jindal Drilling & Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Pioneer refurbishment completion and deployment: completion by first week of September; deployment in October 2026
calls.thesis: Offshore jack-up contractor faces H2 FY27 revenue decline as three of six rigs dehire with 4-6 month refurbishment gaps; new ONGC contract at ~INR45 lakh/day fixed, well below the $62k bid, and redeployment of the other three is unconfirmed.

calls.name: Pyramid Technoplast Ltd
calls.gLine: Capacity utilisation: 70% overall by year end (FY27)
calls.thesis: Utilisation at 62% on 20,936 MT capacity with volumes of 1,292 MT, while revenue rose 36% on price pass-through; management guides FY27 utilisation to 70% and EBITDA margin above 10%.
calls.top: Polymer drum price Rs160 → Rs140 expected

calls.name: Platinum Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: Oleo revenue FY27: INR 65-70 cr (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR 108.9 cr (from 115.4 cr) and consolidated PAT to INR 11.1 cr (from 13.1 cr) as new Palghar capacity ramps from 21 May with utilisation guided at only 30-35%.

calls.name: Ardee Industries Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line growth: 10% to 20% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 35% YoY to Rs 338.8 cr on 17,645 MT volume, but EBITDA flat at Rs 33.8 cr with margin ~10%; capacity expanded 50.9% to 1,56,950 MTPA yet utilisation guided lower at 65% and FY27 volume growth 10-20%.

calls.name: India Pesticides Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 top-line growth: lower single-digit growth (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 9.2% to INR 256 crore on a ~13% volume drop, with inventory building to ~200 days and FY27 top-line guided only to lower single-digit growth.

calls.name: Greenpanel Industries Ltd
calls.thesis: Greenpanel's Q1 FY27 margin gain came from a ~15% price hike now largely rolled back, with MDF capacity utilisation at 50–60% and no guidance given; OEM down 14%, exports zero.
calls.top: Price hikes rolled back across industry

calls.name: Solex Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: FY27 module utilisation assumption: around 55% (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 1.8% to INR265.6 crore and PAT margin fell to 3.1% as ALMM-2 delays pushed module offtake into H2; FY27 guidance held at 5-6% PAT margin with 55% utilisation assumed.

calls.name: K.P. Energy Ltd
calls.gLine: IPP capacity by end FY27: 100 MW (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~126% to Rs 521 cr but gross margin fell to ~20% from 28% in Q4; order book cut to Rs 2,250 cr and FY27 growth guided to 30-40%, with no margin guidance.

calls.name: Camlin Fine Sciences Ltd
calls.gLine: FY28 EBITDA margin: 12-14%
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin collapsed to about 4% from 45% last quarter on raw-material and freight spikes; vanillin plant ran at roughly 25% utilisation, and FY27 vanillin volume guidance cut to about 3,000 tons from 3,600-4,000.
calls.top: FY27 EBITDA guide cut to 10-12% margin

calls.name: Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd
calls.gLine: Central Vista billing FY27: INR700 crores (FY27)
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin fell to 4.29% from 8.59% on AIIMS Jammu bill cut (2.6pp), NCR labour wage hikes and staff costs; double-digit margin for FY27 ruled out and inflow guidance cut.

calls.name: Prostarm Info Systems Ltd
calls.gLine: Working capital days March 2027: 120-150 days
calls.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 76 cr (+38% YoY) with EBITDA margin 8.55%, but operating cash flow still negative (INR 16 cr), receivables INR 231 cr, and the Jhajjar BESS plant is delayed to H1 with FY27 utilisation capped at 20-25%.

calls.name: SRG Housing Finance Ltd
calls.gLine: Business recovery: Q2 slowdown, Q3 and Q4 good
calls.thesis: Management denies a Rs 400 crore siphoning report and says NHB red-flagged the account with no reasons given; disbursements slowed, credit rating under watch, and no audit findings disclosed on a Rs 1,100 crore book.
calls.top: NHB red flag on account, reasons undisclosed

firstTimers.name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹137.1 cr (+103.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin 28.3%, but no capacity cut or discipline signal; 18,000 MVA brownfield added for FY29 with ~1,725 MVA executed in Q1 on 19,200 MVA base.

firstTimers.name: Glass Wall Systems (India) Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Facade maker's first call: Q1 revenue Rs.107 cr (+36% YoY) and EBITDA margin 21.3%, with FY27 guidance of ~25% growth, 23-25% EBITDA margin and Rs.982 cr order book, but no capacity discipline data and a loose order-inflow answer.

firstTimers.name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 recovery-led quarter: recoveries up 151% to INR1,066 crores, but acquisitions fell to INR353 crores and standalone PAT of INR143 crores was flattered by INR120 crores of write-backs; no numeric guidance given.

firstTimers.name: Steamhouse India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Steam volumes up 16.7% YoY with utilisation 41.40% (from 36.06%) and EBITDA/ton ₹1,011, but ~70% of 345 TPH is contracted and capacity is being added toward 705 TPH.

firstTimers.name: Karamtara Engineering Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “My name is Rajiv Singh, and a very warm welcome to the first earnings conference call of Karamtara Engineering Limited as a listed company”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR1,581 crore (+72% YoY) and EBITDA margin ~11% with ramping new capacity; management guides FY27 revenue growth of 60-65% but gives no FY28 number, and capacity utilisation is still low.

firstTimers.name: Purple Style Labs Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Luxury omni-channel retailer in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA at negative INR11 crores vs negative INR4 crores a year ago, PAT loss INR88 crores, and debt rising to INR436 crores despite inventory falling to INR159 crores.

firstTimers.name: Prasol Chemicals Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA INR90.3 cr (20.8% margin) was flattered by ~INR25 cr inventory gain in a price spike; management guides FY27 adjusted EBITDA INR240-250 cr ex-gain, with Phase 1 capex of INR250-300 cr adding ~60,000 t.

firstTimers.name: ESDS Software Solution Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 7.3% YoY to INR133.66 cr with GPU capacity (Sharon AI, 8,200 B300s) not billing until Q3; the story rests on unproven GPU leasing and heavy customer-advance funding.

firstTimers.name: Symbiotec Pharmalab Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 consol revenue INR218 cr (+7% YoY) and EBITDA INR45 cr, with the API core steady at 60%+ gross margin; new CDMO and injectable businesses drag INR23 cr opex and INR11 cr depreciation before revenue starts in H2.

firstTimers.name: Hy-Tech Engineers Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 13% to INR430m but EBITDA margin fell to 19.6% from 21.5%; management attributes it to price pass-through lagging into Q2 and guides ~20% growth and 24-25% margin, with capacity at 60-70% utilisation.

firstTimers.name: Skyways Air Services Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue nearly doubled to INR1,216.53 crore on yield and volume, but management attributes much of the jump to fuel-linked pass-through; volume growth 23% is the cited driver with no capacity or capex signal.

firstTimers.name: Tempsens Instruments (India) Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 33% to INR118 crores, but EBITDA margin fell to 22% from 25.3%; management guides growth in line with the 3-year blend and ~INR500 crores of capacity coming online by Q3 FY28, with utilisation at about 80%.

firstTimers.name: Shankesh Jewellers Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 55% YoY to INR424 cr with EBITDA margin ~14%, but management attributed margin gains to mix without quantification, volumes flat, and no capacity or capex discipline evidence.

firstTimers.name: Gaja Alternative Asset Management Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Asset manager with 100% fee and performance economics; Q1 FY27 PAT up 35% to INR27.2 crore, but performance income (INR29.7 crore) is lumpy and management declined to give forward guidance.

firstTimers.name: Novartis India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Post-takeover Novartis India is rebuilding its commercial model: M&A-led growth, ~INR40–50 crore extra quarterly costs from Q2 and a margin dip, with no supply-side capacity signal.

firstTimers.name: AJC Jewel Manufacturers Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 125% to Rs 101.4 cr with EBITDA margin 4.6%, but management gave no utilisation or capex-cut discipline, Kerala capacity being expanded to 120% while utilisation is ~25%, and CFO has been negative for six years.

firstTimers.name: Horizon Industrial Parks Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Industrial REIT-style platform with 29.5 mn sq ft operational, Q1 revenue INR200 cr (+23%) and 12% re-leasing spreads, but reported net loss of INR12 cr and no capacity-discipline evidence; supply is self-driven expansion, not industry-wide.

firstTimers.name: Molbio Diagnostics Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Molbio's Truenat point-of-care platform is capacity-rich (kits at 58%, devices at 42% utilisation) with guidance of ~25% revenue growth and 24–25% EBITDA; no prior guidance was supplied to check against.

firstTimers.name: Behari Lal Engineering Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin expansion came from mix (high-value 60.4% of revenue, EBITDA/ton ~13,500), but melt capacity is unchanged until Unit 3 next year, with FY27 capex of INR80 crore (only INR5 crore spent in Q1).

firstTimers.name: Shiprocket Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Asset-light shipping and D2C enabler: core transactions +31% with core EBITDA margin 12.8% (+50bps YoY) and emerging EBITDA improving to -24% from -38%, but no capex or supply lever to read.

firstTimers.name: Dhoot Transmission Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue growth near 50% YoY with EBITDA margin up 110bp to 15%, but management guides 15-16% margin only as copper pass-through lags; no capacity-discipline signal beyond 15-20% expansion at two plants.

firstTimers.name: Milky Mist Dairy Food Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR973 crore with EBITDA margin 14.9% vs 12.2% a year ago; growth led by paneer, yogurt and ice cream, with capacity still underutilised (~50% per analyst) and no supply-side discipline signal.

firstTimers.name: LEAP India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Pallet pooling leader LEAP grows revenue 19% and EBITDA 21% in Q1 FY27 while trimming asset capex to INR76 crore from INR110 crore, with utilisation up to 89.2% and no new capacity push.

firstTimers.name: Ardee Industries Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 35% YoY to Rs 338.8 cr on 17,645 MT volume, but EBITDA flat at Rs 33.8 cr with margin ~10%; capacity expanded 50.9% to 1,56,950 MTPA yet utilisation guided lower at 65% and FY27 volume growth 10-20%.

firstTimers.name: MV Electrosystems Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Post-IPO rail propulsion ramp from ~10 units in September to ~40/month by January on a 564-unit order book (INR989 crore); no deliveries in the prior two months, so the thesis rests on unproven execution.

firstTimers.name: Juniper Green Energy Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 with 601 MW commissioned and CUF 30.2%, but no capacity cuts or utilisation tailwind; the story is contracted build-out and a BESS-led pivot, with tariffs and EBITDA guidance that depend on execution.

firstTimers.name: Lohia Corp Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Woven-plastic machinery maker reported Q1 FY27 revenue INR503 cr (+60% YoY) and EBITDA margin 19.9%, with order book ~INR1,778 cr (+30% QoQ) and utilisation of 70-75%, but no capacity added yet.

firstTimers.name: Virat Industries Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Investor-meet call is mostly promoter-led diversification into a Brahm lifestyle platform via Rs95 cr primary investment; socks pricing up to Rs63/pair but no capacity, utilisation or capex disclosure, and forecasts are unsupported.

firstTimers.name: Maximus International Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~52% to INR59.91 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 7.64% from 9.81% on Middle East war input costs; plant utilisation only ~45% of 50,000 KL, so supply is not the constraint.

firstTimers.name: Xtranet Technologies Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 margin jump (EBITDA 20.59%, +855bp) came from services mix shift, not volume; revenue up only 11% with order book ~INR 373 cr and FY27 target of INR 500+ cr (35-40% growth).

firstTimers.name: Solex Energy Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up only 1.8% to INR265.6 crore and PAT margin fell to 3.1% as ALMM-2 delays pushed module offtake into H2; FY27 guidance held at 5-6% PAT margin with 55% utilisation assumed.

firstTimers.name: Allcargo Global Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 EBITDA turned to INR33 crore from a INR17 crore Q4 and a loss last year, but volumes are still below prior levels and management gave no hard numbers beyond a flat dollar cost intent.

firstTimers.name: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Platform premium up 49% to INR 1,204 crores and service EBITDA up 89% to INR 39 crores (13% of revenue), but no capacity or supply-side metric; growth is volume and renewal driven.

firstTimers.name: Flomic Global Logistics Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 18.4% to INR120 cr and EBITDA margin up 275bp to 9.34%, but management attributes most growth to freight rates (volume only +6-7%) and gives no capacity or capex data, so the read is cyclical freight-rate tailwind rather than supply-side evidence.

firstTimers.name: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 22.7% to INR85.2 cr and EBITDA margin up to 10.14% from 7.35%, but growth is export-led; the new Andheri plant adds capacity with domestic sales still mostly unproven.

firstTimers.name: Baroda Extrusion Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Small copper extruder (~Rs 48 cr quarterly revenue, EBITDA margin ~7.7%) with a planned Rs 20-25 cr extrusion press expansion; management talk is heavy on vision and light on numbers, with volume and capacity figures that contradict each other.

firstTimers.name: Hexagon Nutrition Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +43% to INR104.3 cr but EBITDA margin fell to 11.3% from 13.8% on raw-material and freight costs; capacity utilisation rose to 47% from ~30%, while inventory days climbed to ~142 from ~130.

firstTimers.name: Kusumgar Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR247.2 cr (+102% YoY, -21% QoQ) with management declining formal guidance and order-book disclosure; utilisation only 55-60% with no large capex planned, so supply is not yet a constraint.

firstTimers.name: Advit Jewels Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 PAT up 37.9% to INR8.19 crore at 23.1% margin, but call is promotional with no capacity, utilisation or pricing data; B2C/store capex and franchise model still unformed.

firstTimers.name: Laser Power & Infra Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue +15% to INR5,215m and EBITDA +26% to INR659m, but finance cost absorbed 55% of EBITDA; capacity utilisation cited at 62% (manufacturing), with no new capex guidance and a stated focus on utilisation.

firstTimers.name: Caliber Mining And Logistics Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Coal mining and logistics contractor: revenue up ~67% YoY to INR657 cr, but reported EBITDA margin fell to 16.8% (20.0% adjusted vs ~24% a year ago) on diesel spike; FY27 guide 45–50% revenue growth, 35%+ EBITDA growth.

firstTimers.name: Sula Vineyards Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “She has been with Sula for 8 years now and has already taken over the reins, and we welcome her to her first earnings call”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 3% to INR121 cr but gross profit down 5%; grape-mix (~150bp) and geographic-mix (~200bp) hit margins, with management guiding recovery from Q4 FY27 and normalisation by Q1 FY28.

firstTimers.name: Knack Packaging Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “It gives me immense pleasure to welcome all our stakeholders, analysts, investors, and members of the investment community to Knack Packaging Limited's first ever earnings conference call, following our successful listing on the Natio nal S”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue +40.5% to INR2,648m and EBITDA margin 22.4%, but capacity is ~91% utilised with capacity expansion (43.3k to 70k tpa) not due until Oct 2027, and rented plants added in the interim.

firstTimers.name: Axis Solutions Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: No earnings call transcript or analyst / investor meet filing on BSE from 2019 until this call
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 78% YoY to ₹48.98 cr with EBITDA margin 12.7%, but no capacity, utilisation or capex disclosure and management declined to give FY27 numbers, so supply-side read is thin.

firstTimers.name: Meenakshi India Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “A very warm welcome to the first earnings call of Meenakshi India Limited”
firstTimers.thesis: Reported profit driven by Rs 711 lakh other income (incl. Rs 373 lakh unrealised fair value gain); core garment EBITDA margin only ~3.4% on flat revenue of Rs 3,224 lakh, with tariff-driven US discounts still weighing.

firstTimers.name: Protean eGov Technologies Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “Coming to the agenda of this call, I would like to use this opportunity to not only share the Q1 financial update, but given that it's my first investor call, I'm sure all of you would like to hear from me about the future we intend to crea”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1FY27 revenue up 19% YoY to INR251 cr but EBITDA down 38% to INR28 cr (10% margin); management attributes ~INR18 cr to upfront RFP mandate costs and says normalised margin ~17.2%, with no capacity or supply-side signal.

firstTimers.name: Epack Prefab Technologies Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “However, the fact that the margins were subdued because of the West Asia crisis you know which we already called out in the first call and that's expected to normalize, right? In the quarter to come that's expected to normalize”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up ~25% to INR366 cr, order book INR1,380 cr; EBITDA margin fell ~100 bps to 9.4% on steel costs, with management guiding FY27 EBITDA margin 10.5% and FY27 revenue INR1,900-1,950 cr.

firstTimers.name: Trualt Bioenergy Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “Vijay Nirani: A very warm welcome to all the shareholders for the first earnings call for the financial year 2026-2027”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 ethanol volumes ~8.3-8.5 crore litres on ~60% utilisation with a 44 crore litre FY27 order book, but margins rest on cheap grain inventory that management says will fade at INR25.50/kg maize.

firstTimers.name: PTC India Financial Services Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “Rajiv Malhotra, our MD and CEO, on his maiden investor call with PFS”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 disbursement just INR 117 crore with loan book INR 2,946 crore and Stage III INR 190 crore, 187 crore in one NCLT account; growth recovery is promised but not yet evidenced.

firstTimers.name: Digitide Solutions Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “Since this is my first earnings call as a G roup CEO and ED, let me briefly introduce myself and share the perspective I bring to Digitide before discussing our Q1 performance and the outlook”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue INR775 cr (+5.3% YoY, -3.1% QoQ), EBITDA margin 9.9% with TCV down to INR205 cr; management self-selecting out of low-margin accounts and targeting 200 bps margin expansion in FY27.

firstTimers.name: Housing & Urban Development Corporation Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “SANKET CHHEDA – DAM CAPITAL Page 2 of 12 Moderator: Ladies and gentlemen, good day, and welcome to Housing and Urban Development Corporation Limited Q1 FY '27 First Earnings Conference Call, hosted by DAM Capital”
firstTimers.thesis: HUDCO guides FY27 disbursement of about INR65,000 crore and a INR3 lakh crore loan book by 2030, with spreads held near 2%, but the call offers no hard supply-side evidence and sanctions are being chased with lengthy project timelines.

firstTimers.name: Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd
firstTimers.evidence: Transcript: “Good evening, ladies and gentlemen , and welcome to our first earnings call for the financial year 2027”
firstTimers.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 19.1% to Rs 798 crore with EBITDA margin 31.0%, driven by CGHS price pass-through (2-3%) and mix; no supply-side capacity signal as management says capacity is never a constraint.
